Japanese.Text:
ケット・シー
ニブルヘイムは　５年前に燃え落ちた

English.Text:
Uh, Cait? Meant to tell you before,
but the terminal's prob'ly gone.

Japanese.Text: 端末が残っていても　使えるかどうか

English.Text: Nibelheim burned down five years ago.

Japanese.Text:
５年前の事件のことは知っとります
でも　端末の心配なら無用ですわ

English.Text: It did, aye... Not to worry, though. The terminal's as snug as a bug in a rug.

Japanese.Text: あそこはいまでも　神羅の重要施設ですから

English.Text: 'Cause Shinra wasnae about to let that facility burn down.

Japanese.Text: 魔晄炉のことか？

English.Text: Meaning the reactor?

Japanese.Text: あ～　それもですが……

English.Text: Well, that's important too─but no.

Japanese.Text: よく　わっかんないけどさ～

English.Text: I'm no expert on Nibelheim...

Japanese.Text:
端末で調べないかぎり
黒マテリアの場所　わかんないんでしょ？

English.Text: but what I do know is that it's the only lead we have on that materia.

Japanese.Text: んじゃ　行くしかないじゃん

English.Text: So...not much choice.

Japanese.Text: うん……そうだね　行ってみようよ

English.Text: Yeah. It's this or nothing. We should get going.

Japanese.Text: この先が　ニブルヘイムだ

English.Text: Nibelheim's not far now.

Japanese.Text: あれから　帰ってねえんだろ？

English.Text: First time back since...?

Japanese.Text: ああ　５年ぶりだな

English.Text: Yup. First time.

Japanese.Text: 私も……

English.Text: Same here...

Japanese.Text:
ぜんぶ　燃えちゃったって聞いたから
帰っても仕方ないだろうなって

English.Text: Didn't seem worth coming back till now. Didn't think there was anything to come back to.

Japanese.Text: いいのか

English.Text: Sorry...

Japanese.Text: あれから色々　ありましたから

English.Text: It's alright. Lot's happened since then.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　またな～！

English.Text: I'll see ya when I see ya!

Japanese.Text: 待ってくれよ　セフィロス

English.Text: Hey, Sephiroth! Wait up!

Japanese.Text: 俺は　黒マテリアが欲しい

English.Text: Bring me the black materia.

Japanese.Text: くろ……まてりあ……

English.Text: The black...materia...

Japanese.Text: 大丈夫？

English.Text: You okay?

Japanese.Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah.

Japanese.Text: この人も　ニブルヘイムに向かってるみたい

English.Text:
Looks like we're not the only ones
headed for Nibelheim.

Japanese.Text:
コスモキャニオンの黒マントは
オイラたちを呼びに来たのかな？

English.Text: Huh... Almost like they swung by Cosmo Canyon just so they could lead us here.

Japanese.Text: そう思っただけだよ　なんとなく

English.Text: Sorry, just thinking out loud. Forget about it.

Japanese.Text: クラウド　いっしょに行こう

English.Text: Uh... Cloud? Stay close, would you?

Japanese.Text: 想像したら　やっぱり怖くなっちゃって

English.Text: I honestly thought I was ready for this, but...

Japanese.Text: もうすぐだね

English.Text: It's just...too real.

Japanese.Text: うそ……

English.Text: No...

Japanese.Text: どういうことだよ　こりゃあ

English.Text: Wait...what? I thought...

Japanese.Text: クラウド　見て

English.Text: Cloud, look at this.

Japanese.Text: ほら

English.Text: It's...

Japanese.Text: これ　新しいよ

English.Text: It's...brand new.

Japanese.Text: 作り直したんだ　村ごと

English.Text: They rebuilt the whole village.

Japanese.Text:
おどかすなよ
また　おかしくなったのかと──

English.Text:
Don't scare me like that.
Thought Cloud might've lost it ag─

Japanese.Text: いや　またっつーのも　アレだけどよ

English.Text:
I mean, I thought he got us lost.
'Cause it looks different.

Japanese.Text: でも　誰がこんなことしたんだ？

English.Text: So...who do you think rebuilt it?

Japanese.Text: 神羅……

English.Text: Shinra.

Japanese.Text: さ～て　端末を探しましょ！

English.Text: Never mind all that─we've got a terminal to find!

Japanese.Text: こりゃあ……

English.Text: Well, shit...

Japanese.Text: 黒マントだらけだな

English.Text: Lotta robes out here...

Japanese.Text: うん　それに村の人たちも

English.Text: Yeah. And look... "Locals."

Japanese.Text: 知らない人だよね

English.Text: Only they aren't quite the same, are they?

Japanese.Text: この村に　なにかご用ですか？

English.Text: Hello there. Can I help you?

Japanese.Text: ど～も　ど～も！

English.Text: Greetings, good sir!

Japanese.Text: ボク　神羅リゾートの社員です

English.Text: I am a proud employee of Shinra Resorts.

Japanese.Text:
神羅のネットワーク端末をお借りしたくて
ちょっと寄らしてもろたんですわ～

English.Text: And since I was nearby, I thought I might pop in and check something on the company database.

Japanese.Text: うしろの方々は？

English.Text: And your companions?

Japanese.Text: この人たちは

English.Text: Oh them? They're...

Japanese.Text: ここは　私の故郷……でした

English.Text: I used to live here. Until...you know.

Japanese.Text: なるほど

English.Text: I see...

Japanese.Text: ニブルヘイムの　いまの状況はご存知です？

English.Text: And are you aware of what Nibelheim is now?

Japanese.Text: いや　驚いた

English.Text: Nope. No idea.

Japanese.Text:
ここは　５年前から
神羅カンパニーの直接管理区域でしてね

English.Text:
Five years ago, Shinra assumed direct control
over this village.

Japanese.Text: いまは　魔晄中毒の方々の療養所になっています

English.Text:
It now serves as a treatment center
for mako poisoning.

Japanese.Text: 権利関係は処理済みと聞いています

English.Text: All property rights have been transferred.

Japanese.Text:
なにか問題がある場合は
本社の特殊施設管理課へ　ご連絡いただけますか

English.Text: If that's why you're here, contact Special Facilities at corporate. They'll be able to help you.

Japanese.Text: ご親切に　どうも～

English.Text: Very helpful─thank you, sir!

Japanese.Text: 端末　ちゃちゃっとお借りしちゃいますね

English.Text: Ah, but the database. I'll not be a wee minute!

Japanese.Text:
故郷が懐かしい気持ちもわかりますが
どうか　早々にお引き取りを

English.Text:
I'm sure you're eager to see your hometown,
but please, don't stay too long.

Japanese.Text: これ　昔からあった？

English.Text: Question. This always been here?

Japanese.Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah.

Japanese.Text: のぼりたく　なるよね

English.Text: It totally screams "climb me," doesn't it?

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　のぼろう
なに見えるかな？

English.Text:
So, let's give the poor thing what it wants
and see the sights!

Japanese.Text: おい……

English.Text: Hey, don't just─

Japanese.Text: 村……だね　ちゃんと

English.Text: To look at this place...you'd never know...

Japanese.Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah...

Japanese.Text: ねえ　クラウドんちは？

English.Text: So─which one's your house?

Japanese.Text: あれだ

English.Text: That one.

Japanese.Text: へえ～　かわいい

English.Text: Aw, looks cozy.

Japanese.Text: ごめん　無神経だった

English.Text: I'm sorry. I shouldn't have said that.

Japanese.Text:
似せてはいるが　全然違う
だから　なんとも思わない

English.Text: Nah, don't worry about it. It's all new to you.

Japanese.Text:
ほら　あれが宿屋
５年前は　あそこに泊まった

English.Text:
That building right there is the inn...
where I stayed five years ago.

Japanese.Text: あれが　村役場で

English.Text: You got the town hall...

Japanese.Text: あそこが　よろず屋

English.Text: the general store...

Japanese.Text: それから

English.Text: and that there...

Japanese.Text: ティファの家だ

English.Text: Tifa's house.

Japanese.Text: もしかして　ここから見てた？

English.Text: So lemme guess. This is where you kept lookout?

Japanese.Text: ティファのこと　見てたかなって

English.Text: C'mon, you never came up here hopin' she'd wave?

Japanese.Text: そんなこともあったかもな

English.Text: Prob'ly. Sounds like something I'd do.

Japanese.Text: きっと　わたしも見ちゃうな

English.Text:
If I was in your shoes?
I woulda been up here all the time.

Japanese.Text: そんなこと……するはずないだろ

English.Text: What? N-no way. I-I'd never do that.

Japanese.Text: ふ～ん？

English.Text: Mm-hmm.

Japanese.Text: バカにするな

English.Text: That's not funny.

Japanese.Text:
してないよ
ぜんぜん　そんなのない

English.Text: Wasn't trying to be. Honestly. Just wanted to know.

Japanese.Text: そろそろ　降りよう

English.Text: I'm gonna head down.

Japanese.Text: わたしは　もうすこしだけ

English.Text: Think I'm good where I am. I'll see ya later.

Japanese.Text: ひとりにしてください

English.Text: If you don't mind, I'd like to be alone.

Japanese.Text: 怒ってるのか

English.Text: You angry?

Japanese.Text: はい

English.Text: Mm-hmm.

Japanese.Text: 俺か？

English.Text: At me?

Japanese.Text: ううん　ぜんぶ

English.Text: Not at you. At everything.

Japanese.Text: うらやましい

English.Text: Must be nice...

Japanese.Text:
いっしょに懐かしいねって言える友達がいる
子供のころの思い出をいっしょに覚えてる

English.Text: To have a friend you've known since you were a kid. Someone you can say "Remember the time when...?" to. Someone you can reminisce with.

Japanese.Text:
そういうの　すごくうらやましくて
気持ち　もてあましてる

English.Text: I don't have anyone like that...and it feels like I'm being taunted for it. Which stings─more than it should.

Japanese.Text: だから　ひとりにして

English.Text: That is why I wanna be alone.

Japanese.Text: クラウドに　やつあたりしそう

English.Text: Plus, I might take it out on you, and I don't want that.

Japanese.Text: してもいい

English.Text: I don't mind.

Japanese.Text: しない　あとで落ち込むから

English.Text: Well I do. And it'd only make me feel worse.

Japanese.Text: ごめんね　ありがと

English.Text: Thank you, though. Really.

Japanese.Text: もうすこししたら　降りるね

English.Text: I'll be down in a bit. See you then.

Japanese.Text: いい風　いい村だったんだね

English.Text:
Fresh air... Peace and quiet...
Not a bad place to grow up.

Japanese.Text:
ここ　好き
気に入っちゃった

English.Text: I know it's not the village you knew...but it's still nice.

Japanese.Text: パパは……

English.Text: Y'know...

Japanese.Text:
あの日　パパはなぜセフィロスを追って
魔晄炉まで行ったのか

English.Text: I never understood it. Why'd my dad go into the reactor? Why chase Sephiroth?

Japanese.Text:
病院で目を覚ましてから　私……
ずっと　そのことを考えていたの

English.Text:
Thought about it ever since waking up in Corel.
It just seemed liked such a bad idea.

Japanese.Text:
だって　セフィロスに追いついても
パパじゃ　なにもできないよね

English.Text:
I mean, what did he think he was gonna do?
Fight a famous war hero and win?

Japanese.Text: 実際　そうだったし

English.Text: Well, he didn't...

Japanese.Text:
でも　ミッドガルに出て
自分の力で生活するようになって　わかった

English.Text: But after moving to Midgar...after making a life for myself, I finally realized where my dad was coming from.

Japanese.Text: パパはただ　怒ったんだって

English.Text: He was angry. And he'd had enough.

Japanese.Text:
今日は大変だった
でも　明日はきっとよくなる

English.Text: Everything he'd worked so hard for had been destroyed in an instant.

Japanese.Text:
そうやって積み上げてきた
大切な毎日を壊されたことに　パパは怒った

English.Text:
All that he'd built for himself, for us─gone.
Sephiroth had burned it to the ground.

Japanese.Text: その怒りが　パパを動かした

English.Text: That's why he went─even though he had to have known how it'd end.

Japanese.Text: ああ

English.Text: I see.

Japanese.Text: だから私も　悲しい気持ちや　虚しい気持ち

English.Text: And like him, I took my pain, my grief─everything I was feeling...

Japanese.Text:
ぜんぶを　怒りに変えて
アバランチに入ることを決めたの

English.Text:
I took it all and turned it into anger.
Anger that led me to Avalanche.

Japanese.Text: でも　怒りって長く続かないんだ

English.Text: The problem is... Anger doesn't last.

Japanese.Text:
アバランチの活動が過激になるにつれて
疑問や不安が大きくなって

English.Text: So when Avalanche started to become more violent, there wasn't enough left to hold back the fear and the doubt.

Japanese.Text: クラウドと再会したのは　そんな時だった

English.Text: It was taking a toll... Then you turned up.

Japanese.Text: すこしは力になれたか？

English.Text: Have I helped you get through it at all?

Japanese.Text:
うん　クラウドが居てくれたから
ここに帰る決心がついた

English.Text: Yeah, you have. If it wasn't for you, I wouldn't have had the courage to come back here.

Japanese.Text: 運命だな

English.Text: Like it was fate.

Japanese.Text: うん　私もそう思う

English.Text: Yeah, like it was fate.

Japanese.Text: よく覚えてないんだ

English.Text: I...never knew that.

Japanese.Text: そうだよね

English.Text: Yeah... I guess you wouldn't...

Japanese.Text:
色々あったけど
帰ってきて　正解だったな

English.Text:
A lot's happened, but─now that we're here─
I know this was the right decision.

Japanese.Text:
昔に似せて作り直して
なにもなかったみたいにごまかして

English.Text: Because now I know they rebuilt everything─tried to sweep what they did under the rug and pretend it never even happened.

Japanese.Text: こんなの　許せない

English.Text: But I won't let them. I can't.

Japanese.Text: セフィロス　神羅　ぜんぶ大キライ

English.Text:
Sephiroth and his cruelty...Shinra and their lies...
I'm sick of all of it.

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　ここにいた頃
クラウド　よく私のこと見てたよね

English.Text: Hey, remember when we were kids? How you'd─you know─always be looking at me?

Japanese.Text: そうだったか？

English.Text: I, uh... What?

Japanese.Text:
私が見たら　目をそらすの
声をかけると　無視する

English.Text: Every time we made eye contact, you'd look away. And when I tried to talk to you, you'd ignore me.

Japanese.Text: 面倒くさいガキだった　自分でもそう思う

English.Text: Not surprised... I was a pain in the ass as a kid.

Japanese.Text:
私は　誰にも嫌われたくない子だった
いまでも自分のそういうところ　ちょっとキライ

English.Text: I was the opposite. I needed everyone to like me, all the time. Part of me still does, I think. Kinda hate that about myself.

Japanese.Text: しっかりしなくちゃ

English.Text: Gotta get it together.

Japanese.Text: おや　おやおや

English.Text: Well now...who might you be?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　さっきゾロゾロやってきた
フォーリーさんの紹介かい？

English.Text: Ah, that's right─you're the ones Nick was talkin' about. New in town, aren't you?

Japanese.Text: いや……

English.Text: No?

Japanese.Text: ったく　この忙しい時間にもう！

English.Text: In that case, you ought to know better than to interrupt a busy chef, hmm?

Japanese.Text: 邪魔したな

English.Text: I can leave.

Japanese.Text:
べつにいいのよ
話し相手には飢えてるからね

English.Text:
No, no, I don't mind.
Could use someone to talk to anyway.

Japanese.Text: あんた　話し好きには見えないけどさ

English.Text: Then again, I sense you're not much of a chatterbox.

Japanese.Text:
トントントント～ント～ン
私は料理の天才～♪

English.Text:
La la la laaa laaa...
My cooking's like no other♪

Japanese.Text:
トントントント～ント～ン
母さんゆずりなのよ～♪

English.Text:
La la la laaa laaa...
Thanks to my dear old mother, god rest her soul♪

Japanese.Text:
私　ウワサ好き
歌わないと余計なこと～♪

English.Text:
They say I'm always gossiping
No secret's safe with me unless I sing♪

Japanese.Text: ペラペラ～　ペララペラ～♪

English.Text: Blah de blah blah, blah de blah de blah!♪

Japanese.Text: 私は　ウワサ好き～♪

English.Text: Oh, how I love to spill the tea!♪

Japanese.Text: うう……

English.Text: Uhr...

Japanese.Text:
イジワルしないでね
かわいそうな人たちなんだから

English.Text: Now don't you go pickin' on 'em! Those poor folks have got it hard enough already.

Japanese.Text: 魔晄中毒だな

English.Text: Mako poisoning?

Japanese.Text:
そう　でも私が見たところ２種類ね
種類っていうか型？　タイプ？

English.Text: Yep. I'm no expert, but seems to me that there's two types of it. Or, maybe...two types of patients?

Japanese.Text:
時々　体を拭いてあげるんだけどね
数字のイレズミを入れている人が多いんだ

English.Text: We give 'em sponge baths sometimes─and that's when I first saw. Lots of 'em have these...number tattoos.

Japanese.Text: そんで　その人たちには注射かなにかの痕がある

English.Text: That, and needle marks on their arms. Least I think they are.

Japanese.Text: まあ　イレズミも痕もない人もいるけどね

English.Text: Although...we do get the odd one that doesn't seem to have either.

Japanese.Text: あら……ってことは３種類？　４？

English.Text: Wait. That makes it three types, then. Or four?

Japanese.Text: 注射の痕……

English.Text: What needle marks?

Japanese.Text: 中毒の治療の痕じゃないのかい

English.Text: From their treatments, if I had to guess.

Japanese.Text:
数字の意味は？
イレズミの数字だ

English.Text: And the numbers? Got any idea what they mean?

Japanese.Text:
さあねえ
でも　想像がふくらむよねえ

English.Text: Not a clue. Certainly gets the gears in your head turnin' though, doesn't it?

Japanese.Text:
黒マントの人たちは
私が見たところ　２種類ね

English.Text: As I said, there seem to be two types of those black-robed folks.

Japanese.Text:
数字の刺青を入れている人が多いんだ
そんで　その人たちには注射かなにかの痕がある

English.Text: Most have these numbers tattooed on 'em somewhere, but a few have what look like needle marks dotting their arms as well.

Japanese.Text: まあ　刺青も注射の痕もない人もいるけどね

English.Text: Of course, there are those that don't have any such oddity on them at all.

Japanese.Text:
あら……ってことは３種類　あら４？
あらら　あら～♪

English.Text: Wait─did I say two types just now? Or three? Or four? Or...gah!

Japanese.Text: あっちのほう　なんだかイヤな感じがする

English.Text: Something about that place doesn't sit right with me.

Japanese.Text: 神羅屋敷か

English.Text: You mean Shinra Manor?

Japanese.Text:
ごめん　故郷のこと
こんなふうに言われたら　ヤだよね

English.Text: Oh! Sorry... No one wants to hear people badmouth their hometown.

Japanese.Text:
気にするな
ここは俺が育った村とは別物だ

English.Text:
This isn't my hometown.
Not the one I grew up in, anyway.

Japanese.Text: 神羅は　どうしてこんなことしたんだろう

English.Text: Wonder why they'd go through the trouble of rebuilding it...

Japanese.Text:
ああ　俺も……
あの屋敷は　小さい頃から苦手だった

English.Text: Hey, I'm with you. Never liked that place. Just looking at it gives me the creeps.

Japanese.Text: いまはもう使われてないのかな

English.Text: Hopefully the company's not using it anymore...

Japanese.Text: 確かに　いい気はしないな

English.Text: Yeah, does kinda make you feel like shit.

Japanese.Text: ごめんなさい

English.Text: I'm really sorry.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントの人を集めて
神羅はなにをする気なんだろう

English.Text: I keep asking myself "What could Shinra want with all these robed guys?"

Japanese.Text:
黒マントって　まとめて呼んじゃうけど
あの人たちにも　ちゃんとした名前があるんだよね

English.Text: Ah, come to think of it, it's kinda rude we keep calling them "robed guys" and stuff. They've got names, right?

Japanese.Text: 見ろよ　この数

English.Text: They're everywhere you look.

Japanese.Text:
こいつら全員　自分たちの足で
こんなとこまでワラワラやってきたと思うか

English.Text: You don't really think that all these guys decided to get up and shuffle over here of their own accord, do you?

Japanese.Text: ぜーんぶ　神羅の仕業だ！

English.Text: 'Course not─this is Shinra's doin'!

Japanese.Text:
自分たちの都合でブチ壊したり
かと思えば　ニセモノを作ったりよ

English.Text: First they raze a whole village 'cause it suits 'em, then they build a fake one right on top of it...

Japanese.Text:
なんでも　神羅の思いどおりってか？
そうはさせるか！

English.Text: We can't let those corporate bastards keep gettin' away with this shit! We gotta do something, right!?

Japanese.Text: ああ　許せない

English.Text: Hell yeah you're right. Screw them.

Japanese.Text:
おまえの故郷のぶんも
きっちり神羅に思い知らせてやろうぜ

English.Text: That's the spirit─screw 'em! We'll make 'em pay for what they did to y'all's home.

Japanese.Text: 黒マントを集める目的はなんだ

English.Text: I just wanna know what they're rounding 'em up for.

Japanese.Text: 知るかよ　わかってたまるか！

English.Text: The hell if I know... Nothin' good, though.

Japanese.Text: それが　神羅だ

English.Text: Not much we can do.

Japanese.Text: いまだに　元神羅の呪縛か？

English.Text: That shit right there is how they managed to take over the world.

Japanese.Text:
そうやって　神羅だから仕方ねえって
思わせんのが　やつらのやりクチなんだよ

English.Text: They make you beat yourself! They keep tellin' you you're powerless, and eventually you start believin' it.

Japanese.Text:
オレは　ここにいるからよ
神羅がこいつらに悪さしねえか　見張っとくぜ

English.Text: These boys're lucky they got us lookin' out for 'em. If Shinra tries anything, I'll make sure they don't succeed.

Japanese.Text:
正直　５年前のことはよくわかんねえけどよ
おまえとティファのことは心配だ

English.Text: Listen, Cloud... I don't know what went down five years ago, but...I'm here for you and Tifa. Whatever you need.

Japanese.Text: しんどいようなら　村を出ようぜ

English.Text: If it's too much, just say the word. We'll leave.

Japanese.Text: 幼なじみとか　いないのか？ かわいい女の子とかさ

English.Text: So, any friends here you wanna see? Maybe a girlfriend?

Japanese.Text: ってか　俺がいま いっちばん好きな子の話　聞く？

English.Text: Speaking of which, I'll bet you're dying to hear about mine. Am I right?

Japanese.Text: 興味ないってか？

English.Text: What? "Not interested"?

Japanese.Text: いいから聞けって

English.Text: I'mma tell ya anyway!

Japanese.Text: すっごく　かわいいんだ

English.Text: She's real pretty.

Japanese.Text: いや　美人かな

English.Text: No─beautiful.

Japanese.Text: 見る角度によるな　うん

English.Text: Kinda depends on the angle...

Japanese.Text: っていうか　なにより性格！

English.Text: She's just great to be around!

Japanese.Text: ミッドガルの子か？

English.Text: She from Midgar?

Japanese.Text: ああ　都会の子

English.Text: Yup, real city mouse.

Japanese.Text: ザックス……

English.Text: Zack...

Japanese.Text: ザックス・フェア

English.Text: Zack Fair.

Japanese.Text:
エアリスが好きだったソルジャー
ゴンガガ生まれの　俺の同僚

English.Text:
From Gongaga. Head over heels for Aerith.
We fought together as SOLDIERs...

Japanese.Text:
５年前　俺たちは
いっしょに　ここに来たのか

English.Text:
You were here with me five years ago.
You came with me on the mission.

Japanese.Text: ザックス　どこにいるんだ？

English.Text: Where are you? What happened to you?

Japanese.Text:
この先が魔晄炉か～
ねえ　クラウドは行ったことあんの？

English.Text: Looks like the reactor's not too far... Hey, Cloud. Ever been up there before?

Japanese.Text: まあな

English.Text: Yeah.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉があるってことは
魔晄がいっぱいってことでしょ

English.Text: Oho? Then gimme the skinny! What was it like? Was there buttloads of mako?

Japanese.Text: ねえ　貴重なマテリアとかあった？

English.Text: What about, say, oh...materia?

Japanese.Text: ああ　天然のマテリアがあったな

English.Text: Yup. Some of 'em even formed naturally.

Japanese.Text:
天然モノ～！　マジで？
うわ～　ヨダレ出そ～

English.Text:
No. Way. "Naturally"!?
Oh man, ya got my mouth waterin'!

Japanese.Text: どうだったかな

English.Text: Dunno. Never thought to look.

Japanese.Text: もう　これだからシロートは

English.Text: Ugh, freakin' amateurs. Honestly!

Japanese.Text:
やっぱり　マテリア専門家のアタシが
直接　見に行かないとね～

English.Text: Guess it's true what they say... If you want somethin' done right, you really do gotta do it yourself!

Japanese.Text: そんなものは　ない

English.Text: Come to think of it...nope.

Japanese.Text: そうやってごまかして　独り占めする気？

English.Text:
Uh-huh, nice try, but you can't fool me.
I know what you're up to!

Japanese.Text: だまされるもんか！

English.Text: You want it all for yourself!

Japanese.Text: はやく　マテリア探しに行こうよ～

English.Text: What are we waitin' for? That materia needs me!

Japanese.Text: 端末が先だな

English.Text: Terminal first.

Japanese.Text: ケット・シーは役場か

English.Text: Should check on Cait Sith...

Japanese.Text: あのネコ氏　何者なんですか？

English.Text: So, what's the story here, exactly?

Japanese.Text:
端末を貸したら　コネだのツテだの
なんだかんだで　中枢のデータベースまで

English.Text: Because for a cat, he has an awfully high level of clearance. It's more than a little suspicious.

Japanese.Text: グループ会社のいち社員とは　とても思えません

English.Text: No "average employee" should be able to access what he can.

Japanese.Text:
この村のことを聞かれても
答えられることはありませんよ

English.Text: I understand this must be confusing for you, but I don't know anything either.

Japanese.Text: 私も雇われて　ここにいるだけですから

English.Text: I just go where the company tells me. That's it.

Japanese.Text: ちょ～っと　待っててください

English.Text: Gonna need a smidge more time.

Japanese.Text: いまのうちに村の様子　見てきたらいかがです？

English.Text: Why not visit some of your old haunts while you have the chance?

Japanese.Text: いろいろ思い出しちゃうかもしれませんけど

English.Text: You never know, you might remember somethin' nice...

Japanese.Text: ウニャ～～～！

English.Text: I cannae believe this!

Japanese.Text:
この端末からじゃダメですわ
アクセスできる範囲が制限されとります

English.Text:
I shoulda known it was too good to be true...
I only have limited access from this console.

Japanese.Text: つまり　情報は手に入らない

English.Text: Lemme guess. "Limited" doesn't cut it.

Japanese.Text: あきらめるんは　まだ早いですわ！

English.Text: Nope...but all is not lost!

Japanese.Text:
管理人はん　あのお屋敷に
入れてもらえませんやろか？

English.Text: Excuse me, good sir! Would you be so kind as to grant us entry into Shinra Manor?

Japanese.Text: あなたなら　入れるのでは？

English.Text: Don't you have clearance for that?

Japanese.Text: にゃっは～　無理に決まってますやろ

English.Text: Oh, if only! I'm but a wee bottom-feeder.

Japanese.Text: ボク　神羅リゾートの平社員でっせ

English.Text: Barely have clearance to use the bathroom, me!

Japanese.Text:
私のカードでも　あそこには入れません
上司と交渉してください

English.Text: Be that as it may, I can't let you in there myself. You'll have to ask my boss instead.

Japanese.Text:
ジョーシ！
カチョーはん　ブチョーはん？

English.Text:
Meaning the deputy commissioner?
Or...the commish himself?

Japanese.Text: どこにおりますのやろ？

English.Text: Let's meet 'n' greet!

Japanese.Text:
ムラサキ課長は　本社からの点検依頼で
ニブル魔晄炉に滞在中です

English.Text: Deputy Commissioner Murasaki's up at the reactor─conducting an inspection for corporate.

Japanese.Text:
明後日には戻る予定ですが
昨日から連絡ないんですよね

English.Text: He's due back the day after tomorrow, but...he hasn't been in touch to confirm.

Japanese.Text: 遅れるかもしれませんねえ

English.Text: Could be he needs more time.

Japanese.Text: そんなに　待てませんわ～

English.Text: Ach, we cannae afford to dillydally!

Japanese.Text: 急ぎだ　こっちから行こう

English.Text: Then we'll just have to track him down.

Japanese.Text: そうしましょ！

English.Text: Agreed!

Japanese.Text: ほな　おおきに～

English.Text: Thanks for all the help, pal.

Japanese.Text: 端末をお貸ししたことは　どうぞ他言無用で

English.Text: Please, don't tell anyone I let you touch our terminal.

Japanese.Text: はあ　早くジュノン支社に戻りたい

English.Text: ...Get me the hell out of this backwater.

Japanese.Text: 聞いたよ　魔晄炉行くんでしょ？

English.Text: So! You're headed to the reactor, huh?

Japanese.Text: 魔晄炉だあ？　端末の件は片付いたのか

English.Text:
"Headed to the reactor"?
No luck at town hall, I take it?

Japanese.Text:
カードキーが必要になった
魔晄炉へ行って　ムラサキという男に会ってくる

English.Text: Gotta get a keycard. A guy named Murasaki has it, but he's inspecting the reactor.

Japanese.Text: はい　ハイハイハイ～！　アタシも行く

English.Text:
Well then, you'll need a ninja to accompany you!
I'm comin' with.

Japanese.Text: 私も

English.Text: Me too.

Japanese.Text: いや　ティファは……

English.Text: Really? You sure...?

Japanese.Text: この村で　いちばんのガイドといえば　私

English.Text: "Ask anyone around here. I'm the best there is."

Japanese.Text: わかった

English.Text: Alright.

Japanese.Text: おまえら　大丈夫か

English.Text: You sure you're gonna be okay?

Japanese.Text:
山に登ってカードキーを借りるだけだ
問題ない

English.Text:
We're going on a hike and getting a keycard.
How tough can it be?

Japanese.Text:
しばらく　戻れないと思うけど
やり残したことはない？

English.Text:
You'll still be gone for a while.
Sure there's nothin' you need to take care of?

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　準備よろしく！
急がないと　マテリア逃げちゃうよ～？

English.Text:
I'm puttin' you in charge of provisions...
but make it snappy! My materia needs me!

Japanese.Text: シュシュッと出発する？

English.Text: We goin' to the reactor or what?

Japanese.Text: 最近できた橋を使えば　近道できるみたいでっせ

English.Text: New bridge just went in, you know─might shave some time off the trip!

Japanese.Text: よ～し　いざ　しゅっぱーつ！

English.Text: Sounds like a plan to me! Alright, reactorward ho!

Japanese.Text: 社長

English.Text: Sir.

Japanese.Text:
ニブルヘイムへ向かわせた調査隊が
何者かに襲われたようです

English.Text:
We've received word about the Nibelheim
survey team. It appears they were ambushed.

Japanese.Text: ウータイか？

English.Text: By Wutai?

Japanese.Text: いよいよ始まりますな　若！

English.Text: Indeed. And so it begins!

Japanese.Text: はやく行こ～！

English.Text: Hurry it up already!

Japanese.Text: 新しい橋は　あっちだね

English.Text: That the new bridge I see up ahead?

Japanese.Text: 寄り道してる場合じゃないって～

English.Text: Hey! Keep your eyes on the prize, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: 助けてくれ！

English.Text: Help!

Japanese.Text: ザックス！

English.Text: Zack!

Japanese.Text: あいつの運に　期待しよう

English.Text: He's in fate's hands now.

Japanese.Text: どうしたの？

English.Text: What is it?

Japanese.Text: 思い出したんだ　ザックスのこと

English.Text: I remember what happened here. And to Zack.

Japanese.Text: うん……

English.Text: Oh...

Japanese.Text:
吊り橋から落ちて　ここから流されていった
そして　おそらく

English.Text: Bridge broke, he fell. Got swept away by the current. I think he's...

Japanese.Text: 死んだ

English.Text: dead.

Japanese.Text:
ティファは　覚えてたんじゃないか？
だから……

English.Text:
You never forgot, did you?
That's why you've been acting weird.

Japanese.Text: 触れないほうがいいのかなって

English.Text: Didn't wanna upset you. That's all.

Japanese.Text:
ザックスは友達だった
それなのに忘れるなんて

English.Text:
Zack was my friend.
How could I just forget him like that?

Japanese.Text: 劣化か……

English.Text: Degradation.

Japanese.Text: 俺もからっぽで　さまようのか

English.Text: It's hollowing me out. Bit by bit...

Japanese.Text: 違うよ

English.Text: You're wrong.

Japanese.Text: クラウドは　思い出したんだよ

English.Text: You remembered, Cloud.

Japanese.Text: 良かったじゃない

English.Text: It'll be okay.

Japanese.Text: うん……良かった

English.Text: It will. I know it.

Japanese.Text: そうだな

English.Text: Thanks.

Japanese.Text: ザックスのこと　エアリスにも伝えないとな

English.Text:
We gotta tell Aerith about this.
She deserves to know what happened.

Japanese.Text: うん

English.Text: Yeah.

Japanese.Text: でも　私にまかせてくれる？

English.Text: Yeah, she does...but lemme be the one to do it.

Japanese.Text: ああ……

English.Text: Why?

Japanese.Text: 友達だから　ね？

English.Text: Because she and I are close...y'know?

Japanese.Text: ねえ　ま～だ～？

English.Text: Hey─are you two done yet?

Japanese.Text: ごめん　すぐ行く

English.Text: Yup. Be right there!

Japanese.Text: この話はみんなにも内緒で

English.Text: Let's just keep this between the two of us. Promise?

Japanese.Text: おえ　くるしい……

English.Text: Ugh, I'm dyin' here...

Japanese.Text: 早めに抜けるぞ　濃すぎる魔晄は危険だ

English.Text: Let's not waste any time. Mako this thick is dangerous.

Japanese.Text: 魔晄の泉だ

English.Text: A mako spring.

Japanese.Text: これ　ぜ～んぶ　マテリアなの？

English.Text: Wait, so...this whole thing's materia?

Japanese.Text: ５年前より　すごいね

English.Text: Wow... It's so much bigger.

Japanese.Text: 天然のマテリアだ

English.Text: Naturally formed materia.

Japanese.Text: マテリアは　魔晄エネルギーが凝縮されたもの

English.Text: And look at the size of it. Astounding.

Japanese.Text:
自然の状態で　ここまでになるには
いったい　どれほどの時間が掛かることか

English.Text:
For the mako energy to condense into something
like this, it must have taken an eternity.

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　先へ行こう？
このあたりも　濃いよね

English.Text: Hey─we should get outta here. All this mako's making me queasy.

Japanese.Text: さんせ～

English.Text: Yeah...me too.

Japanese.Text: ねえ　魔晄炉まだ～？

English.Text: Are you sure...we're going the right way?

Japanese.Text: もうすぐだよ　ここを登っていけば

English.Text: We're almost there. Once we get past this part... Then...

Japanese.Text: 別の道を探すしかなさそうだ

English.Text: C'mon, let's find another route.

Japanese.Text: アタシにまかせて

English.Text: No need to worry. I've already found one!

Japanese.Text: これで登っちゃお！

English.Text: More climbing, but hey.

Japanese.Text:
このルートは　さすがにガイドしたことないな
ユフィ　大丈夫？

English.Text: You know...I can't say I've ever taken this route before. You gonna be okay, Yuffie?

Japanese.Text:
これぐらいラクショ～！
ウータイには　もっとすんごいのがあるよ

English.Text: Oh yeah, no problem! This is nothin' compared to what we got in Wutai.

Japanese.Text:
断崖絶壁に　巨大なダチャオ様が彫ってあってね
シノビの修行で　そこを登らされんの

English.Text: Like the massive sculpture of Da-chao carved into the face of this one cliff. All us ninjas have to scale it─part of our training.

Japanese.Text: つらかったけど　ごほーびがあったから

English.Text: Never liked the climb much, but I freakin' loved the reward!

Japanese.Text: ごほうび？

English.Text: Which was...?

Japanese.Text: ダチャオ豆！

English.Text: Da-chao beans, of course!

Japanese.Text:
ゴールしたらもらえるの
ここ登りきったら　ふたりにもあげよっか？

English.Text: Got to eat up when we made it to the top. Ah! Tell you what. I'll give you some when we finish our climb!

Japanese.Text: う～ん　遠慮しとく

English.Text: That's kind, but...you really don't have to.

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　探してる人って
ムラサキって名前なんだよね

English.Text: Hey, Cloud. I've been thinkin'... We're lookin' for a guy named "Murasaki," right?

Japanese.Text: それがどうした？

English.Text: What about him?

Japanese.Text: いや　ウータイっぽい名前だなと思って

English.Text: It's just...his name sounds Wutaian...

Japanese.Text:
戦争の前は　移住者も少なくなかった
２世や３世が神羅にいても　おかしくはない

English.Text: I'm sure plenty of your people immigrated to Midgar before the war. Some of their kids and grandkids probably work for Shinra.

Japanese.Text: そっか　神羅にもウータイ人がいるんだ

English.Text: Oh. Huh... I hadn't ever thought about that before.

Japanese.Text: どこから　降りよっか

English.Text: Gotta be a way to get down...

Japanese.Text: おろ～？

English.Text: No goin' through...

Japanese.Text: 行き止まりだ

English.Text: Well, shit.

Japanese.Text: どうにかできないかな　調べてみよう

English.Text: There has to be something we can use to climb that fence...

Japanese.Text:
でもよく考えたら　ウータイにも
元神羅の人がいるから　お互いさまか

English.Text: Hmm... I guess it's not that weird for people to move to different countries. And it's not like we don't welcome foreigners into Wutai either.

Japanese.Text: ほら　前に話したでしょ？

English.Text: I mean, take Colonel Lodbrok.

Japanese.Text:
暫定政府を作ってくれた
三羽ガラスとスフール総督のこと

English.Text: He and Viceroy Sarruf are the whole reason we have an interim government in the first place.

Japanese.Text:
そういえば　三羽ガラスのグレン大佐も
神羅から抜けた元ソルジャーって言ってたから

English.Text: In fact, his whole team is made up of nothin' but ex-SOLDIERs. Buncha badasses who decided to give Shinra the finger.

Japanese.Text: クラウドと　いっしょだね

English.Text: Kinda like you!

Japanese.Text: いっしょにするな

English.Text: Nothing like me.

Japanese.Text:
ウータイに来たら　紹介してあげよっか
そのまま暫定政府に入っちゃう？

English.Text: Got so much in common you'd be best buds! Just sayin'─it's never too late to join the cause!

Japanese.Text: ねえ　いい考えじゃない？

English.Text: So whaddya say? Wanna join up?

Japanese.Text:
ゴタゴタが　ぜ～んぶ片付いたらさ
みんなで　ウータイにくればいいじゃん

English.Text: I'm dead serious, y'know. I really think you'd like it in Wutai. Could bring the whole gang even!

Japanese.Text: で　暫定政府のユフィ部隊として神羅と戦うの

English.Text: We'll start our own spec ops unit! The "Yuffie Recon Patrol"!

Japanese.Text:
神羅軍を次々と壊滅していく最強のユフィ部隊
それを指揮するのは　美少女隊長のユフィ！

English.Text: Shinra will be afraid to even speak our name. They'll stand in awe of the fair ninja who leads her loyal minions, and tremble in fear when they see the YRPs comin' in hot!

Japanese.Text: ク～　映画化まちがいナシ　ね？

English.Text: People'll be bangin' down the door to buy our film rights!

Japanese.Text:
よし　そうと決まったら
さっさとゴタゴタを片付けちゃお～！

English.Text: Your stunned silence says more than words ever could! I knew you'd be on board!

Japanese.Text: 勝手に決めるな

English.Text: Please shut up.

Japanese.Text: シノビだよ　ウータイの！

English.Text: They're ninjas! From Wutai!

Japanese.Text: これ　戦争？

English.Text: Which means...we're at war?

Japanese.Text:
アタシの任務　どうなっちゃうの
方針変更……？

English.Text:
But...what about my mission?
Did command call it off?

Japanese.Text: 聞いてないよ……

English.Text: Why didn't anyone tell me!?

Japanese.Text: いまは休戦中だよね

English.Text: Aren't we in the middle of a cease-fire, though?

Japanese.Text:
そのはずだ
でも　どうだろうと

English.Text: That's what they say. Still─doesn't mean we are.

Japanese.Text: 死んだヤツらには　同じことだ

English.Text: And it makes no difference to them either way.

Japanese.Text: 行くぞ　ムラサキを探そう

English.Text: C'mon. We gotta find Murasaki.

Japanese.Text: うん

English.Text: Right...

Japanese.Text: 始めたんだ……始まったんだ

English.Text: This is it... There's no turning back.

Japanese.Text: 誰かいるの　ウータイの人？

English.Text: Who's there!? We're here to help!

Japanese.Text: やるぞ！

English.Text: Ready?

Japanese.Text: ムラサキさんを　探そう

English.Text: We gotta find Murasaki.

Japanese.Text: ひどい……

English.Text: Oh my god...

Japanese.Text: さっきのヤツだな

English.Text: That thing must've done this...

Japanese.Text: いや　銃でやられてる

English.Text: I doubt it. They were shot.

Japanese.Text: どうして　こんなこと……

English.Text: Why'd they do this?

Japanese.Text: なにも　聞いてないの？

English.Text: No one told you anything?

Japanese.Text: 知らないよ！

English.Text: No, nothing!

Japanese.Text:
なにが起きてるのか　ぜんぜんわかんない
アタシ　まだなんにも役に立ってない！

English.Text: I had no idea they were planning an operation. I should've been here─should've done something for them.

Japanese.Text: 俺たちの役には立ってる　冷静にな

English.Text: You've done tons for us. Remember that.

Japanese.Text: わかってる

English.Text: Whatever.

Japanese.Text: ティファ……

English.Text: Tifa.

Japanese.Text: ごめん　大丈夫

English.Text: It's okay... I'm okay.

Japanese.Text: 見て！

English.Text: Hey.

Japanese.Text: この人が　ムラサキみたい

English.Text: I think we found our guy.

Japanese.Text: 奥も確認しておこう　生存者がいるかもしれない

English.Text:
We need to check the inside.
There might still be survivors.

Japanese.Text: うん

English.Text: Yeah.

Japanese.Text: 誰もいないね

English.Text: I don't see anyone...

Japanese.Text: セフィロス！

English.Text: Sephiroth!

Japanese.Text: もうすぐだ　クラウド

English.Text: Soon, Cloud. Soon.

Japanese.Text: 大丈夫？

English.Text: You okay?

Japanese.Text: ああ……

English.Text: Yeah...

Japanese.Text: おろ　ケット・シー？

English.Text: Huh!? Cait Sith?

Japanese.Text: ユフィはんでっか　いまどこにおります？

English.Text: Ah, Yuffie! And where might you be?

Japanese.Text: 魔晄だまりの　奥の部屋だ

English.Text: Back room off mako storage.

Japanese.Text: そっちは？

English.Text: You?

Japanese.Text: 役場ですわ

English.Text: Town hall still.

Japanese.Text:
なにか　お手伝いできるかと思って
魔晄炉の端末にアクセスしてみたんですが

English.Text: Thought I might be able to do something from here, so I tried accessing the reactor terminal...

Japanese.Text: ムラサキはんには会えましたか？

English.Text: Anyway, did you find Murasaki?

Japanese.Text: 死んでいた　ウータイと戦闘があったようだ

English.Text: Yeah, we did. He died in a skirmish with Wutai.

Japanese.Text: なんと！

English.Text: He what!?

Japanese.Text:
ややこしいことになる前に
神羅屋敷の端末　借りちゃいましょ

English.Text: Then we don't have much time. We have to reach the terminal in Shinra Manor before word gets out.

Japanese.Text: カードキーはあります？

English.Text: You've got the keycard, right?

Japanese.Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　その端末に差し込んでください

English.Text: Good. Then slot it into the console.

Japanese.Text:
こっちで遠隔操作して
屋敷の門　開けてみますわ

English.Text: I'll work my magic from here. Should have that gate open before you know it.

Japanese.Text: バッチリですわ！

English.Text: Yes! Get in there, my son!

Japanese.Text: 先に屋敷へ向かって　端末探しときます

English.Text: I'll go ahead and look for the terminal. See ye there.

Japanese.Text: わかった　あとでな

English.Text: Meet at the manor. Got it.

Japanese.Text: はいな！

English.Text: Cheerio!

Japanese.Text: またね！

English.Text: Seeya!

Japanese.Text: 戻ろう

English.Text: Let's go.

Japanese.Text: 屋敷に行ったら　まず端末を探しましょ

English.Text: Well, you heard them. Time is of the essence.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドはんたちが戻るまでに
ちゃちゃっと見つけまっせ～

English.Text:
We need to find that terminal─
ideally before they get back.

Japanese.Text: りょーかい

English.Text: Yessir!

Japanese.Text:
おまえは　クラウドたちを待て
合流できたら　オレたちのところへ連れてこい

English.Text: You stay behind and wait for 'em. Once they arrive, you can put that nose of yours to work.

Japanese.Text: その鼻で辿れんだろ？

English.Text: Follow our scent right to us.

Japanese.Text: おまえにしかできねえから　頼んでるんだ

English.Text: Ya gotta admit, you're the best one for the job.

Japanese.Text: ならば　仕方あるまい

English.Text: I will concede you have a point.

Japanese.Text: ほな　行きましょ！

English.Text: Then let's get a move on!

Japanese.Text: クラウドたちは　まだ戻ってきてないよ

English.Text: Um...the others aren't back yet.

Japanese.Text: クラウドたちと合流したら　追いかけるよ

English.Text: We'll catch up with you at the manor later.

Japanese.Text:
ずいぶん金のかかった内装じゃねえか
あちこち　ボロボロだけどよ

English.Text: They pulled out all the stops decoratin' this place. Definitely seen better days though.

Japanese.Text: かれこれ　築５０年ほどになりますやろか

English.Text: Ah, what's a few cracks between friends? It's almost fifty years old.

Japanese.Text: ここ　どんなお屋敷？

English.Text: This can't just be a fancy house...

Japanese.Text: ボクも　詳しくは知りません

English.Text: I'm gonna go out on a limb and agree with you there.

Japanese.Text:
けど　村に黒マントの人たち
ぎょーさんおりましたやろ？

English.Text: The village is practically drowning in a sea of black robes, after all.

Japanese.Text: 関係あんのか

English.Text: So what if it is?

Japanese.Text:
ここは　宝条博士が
実験に使ってたと聞いたことがあります

English.Text: Well...it would add weight to the rumor that Hojo used to conduct experiments here.

Japanese.Text: ロクでもねえな

English.Text: Doubt it's just a rumor.

Japanese.Text: うわ　すごい

English.Text: Kinda creepy...

Japanese.Text: ガキの秘密基地かよ

English.Text: This a kids' clubhouse?

Japanese.Text: う～ん　危険な罠かもしれません

English.Text: Oh, I think it's a bit more dangerous than that.

Japanese.Text: ためしに　ボクが行ってみますわ

English.Text: But nae bother! I'll protect ye!

Japanese.Text: なんや？

English.Text: Uh...

Japanese.Text: 我が屋敷へようこそ　侵入者の諸君

English.Text: Hello, and welcome to Shinra Manor...trespassers.

Japanese.Text: 宝条！

English.Text: Hojo!

Japanese.Text:
君たちが　どこの誰かは知らんが
残念ながら　ここは放棄された施設でね

English.Text:
I don't know what it is you hoped to find here,
but I'm afraid this facility has been abandoned
for some time.

Japanese.Text:
あさったところで
有益なものは残されていないと思うが

English.Text:
Everything of value is gone─but please feel free
to poke around.

Japanese.Text: これ　ただの管理ＡＩです

English.Text: Ah, it's not him─just an AI caretaker.

Japanese.Text:
ただ　少しばかり思い出深い場所でね
我がもの顔で踏み荒らすのは勘弁してもらいたい

English.Text: That said, this facility has always had a place in my heart. I must insist that you leave it in the condition in which you found it.

Japanese.Text: と　いうわけでだ

English.Text: And with that in mind...

Japanese.Text: 不届き者は　お引き取り願おう

English.Text: I won't keep you any longer. Thanks for dropping in.

Japanese.Text: いたたた……

English.Text: Aw... That was a sore one.

Japanese.Text: お～い　お～い！

English.Text: Don't walk into the light, Barret!

Japanese.Text: やってくれるぜ　あの野郎

English.Text: That shithead is gonna get it.

Japanese.Text: 閉じ込められちゃったみたい

English.Text: I think we're trapped in here.

Japanese.Text:
エーアイかなんだか知んねえが
宝条は　宝条ってこった

English.Text: Like rats in a cage. No squeezin' through those bars.

Japanese.Text: あのダクト　ボクやったら通れるかも

English.Text: That duct, however, might just fit a cat.

Japanese.Text: ボク　ちょっと行ってきますわ

English.Text: Sit tight. I'll have you out in a jiffy!

Japanese.Text: これは届きませんな～

English.Text: Argh... Gutted. Just out of reach.

Japanese.Text: おい　どんな調子だ？

English.Text: Hey, cat! How's it lookin'!?

Japanese.Text: そっちから　開けられない？

English.Text: Do you still think you can get us outta here?

Japanese.Text: うまくいったね

English.Text: The cat of the hour.

Japanese.Text: ここはぜ～んぶ　ボクにまかせてください！

English.Text: Just you leave the problem-solvin' to me, eh?

Japanese.Text: さあ　先へ進みましょ！

English.Text: You're in safe paws now!

Japanese.Text: エラー発生　リフトを停止します

English.Text: Error detected. Service suspended.

Japanese.Text: あれが　ワルさしとるみたいやな～

English.Text: So near and yet so far.

Japanese.Text: 電力が足りません　発電機を起動してください

English.Text: Insufficient power. Generator on standby.

Japanese.Text: あれま　どないしよ

English.Text: Talk about a hard landin'.

Japanese.Text: 下になんか置かんと

English.Text: Something to catch it, maybe?

Japanese.Text: ありがと

English.Text: Thank you.

Japanese.Text: いえいえ　お安いご用です～

English.Text: Don't mention it. All in a day's work!

Japanese.Text:
発電機の動作不良を確認
現在ゲートをロックしております

English.Text: Error detected in power generator. Lockdown protocol engaged.

Japanese.Text:
赤く点灯している発電機に
魔晄促進剤を投入してください

English.Text:
Insufficient mako.
Administer accelerant to red generator.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄濃度の上昇を確認
引き続き　魔晄促進剤を投入してください

English.Text: Mako levels increasing. Additional accelerants required to meet operational standard.

Japanese.Text: 魔晄濃度が規定値に達しました

English.Text: Sufficient mako levels confirmed.

Japanese.Text: 発電機の稼働を確認　ロックを解除します

English.Text: Generator online. Lockdown protocol disengaged.

Japanese.Text: 電力が足りません　発電機を起動してください

English.Text: Insufficient power. Generator on standby.

Japanese.Text: またかいな

English.Text: Sounds about right...

Japanese.Text: 発電機は　上の階にあるみたいですね

English.Text:
Accordin' to this, that generator's
somewhere upstairs.

Japanese.Text:
なるほど　なるほど
ダクトを通れば　なんとか

English.Text: Well, nothin' else for it. Back into the air ducts I go.

Japanese.Text: これから　どうするの？

English.Text: Sure you'll be okay?

Japanese.Text: 問題ありません！

English.Text: Positive!

Japanese.Text:
ボクにドーンとまかせて
おふたりは　ここで待っといてください

English.Text:
I'll be in and out before you know it.
Don't have too much fun without me!

Japanese.Text:
メンテナンスモードへ移行
ダクト操作をマニュアルへと切り替えます

English.Text: Switching ventilation system to maintenance mode. Enabling duct access.

Japanese.Text: 整備班は点検を開始してください

English.Text: Please commence on-site inspection.

Japanese.Text: ダクトを切り替えました

English.Text: Cycling duct.

Japanese.Text: まずはダクトを切り替えんと

English.Text: Got to get the thing open first.

Japanese.Text: これは　どないしよ

English.Text: ...Right then!

Japanese.Text:
重量測定リフトを稼働します
作業員はリフトに荷物を運んでください

English.Text: Elevator in service. Commence transfer of cargo onto loading bay to proceed.

Japanese.Text:
こっから　あっちに箱を投げたら
いけるんとちゃう？

English.Text: A few boxes ought to do the trick. Now, let's see.

Japanese.Text:
重量が規定値に達していません
引き続き　リフトに荷物を運んでください

English.Text: Error: insufficient weight for elevator operation. Additional cargo required.

Japanese.Text:
重量不足です
引き続き　荷物を運んでください

English.Text:
Weight insufficient for operation.
Additional cargo required.

Japanese.Text:
重量が規定値に達しました
作業員はリフトから荷物をおろしてください

English.Text: Sufficient cargo weight confirmed. Commence transfer of cargo from loading bay to proceed.

Japanese.Text: なんや？

English.Text: What now...?

Japanese.Text: こっちこんとってーーー！

English.Text: Stay back, I'm warnin' you!

Japanese.Text: あ～　しんど！

English.Text: Never again...

Japanese.Text: だいじょうぶ？

English.Text: You okay!?

Japanese.Text:
ちょっと休んどっただけです～
さあ　はやく上に行きましょ！

English.Text:
Och, all the better for a wee lie down!
So then, onwards and upwards?

Japanese.Text:
点検作業のためリフトを一時停止します
しばらくお待ちください

English.Text: Elevator operation suspended for safety inspection. Please wait.

Japanese.Text: 点検終了　リフトの運転を再開します

English.Text: Inspection complete. Resuming operation.

Japanese.Text: あ～もう　次はなんや！

English.Text: Oh, for cryin' out loud! What is it this time!?

Japanese.Text: その先は解除キーが必要でね

English.Text: You'll require the password to proceed.

Japanese.Text: 出やがった！

English.Text: You again!?

Japanese.Text: おっと　勘違いしないでくれたまえ

English.Text: Now now, no need for violence.

Japanese.Text:
私は君たちが出られるように
手助けしにきたんだ

English.Text: I come in peace─and to abet your escape as well.

Japanese.Text: 信じられっか！

English.Text: Hmph, like hell you do!

Japanese.Text: 思いのほか　君たちがしぶとくてね

English.Text:
Really, it's true!
You're far more resilient than anticipated.

Japanese.Text:
これ以上　ここで暴れられるよりは
穏便に退出してもらう方が合理的と判断したまでさ

English.Text:
And I concluded that, rather than allow you to
run amok any longer, I ought to help you see yourselves out peacefully.

Japanese.Text: 解除キーは　４組の２桁の数字だったはずだ

English.Text:
The password is comprised of four
two-digit numbers.

Japanese.Text:
たしか　この部屋のどこかに
書かれていたと思うが

English.Text: I wrote them down in this very room, but...where?

Japanese.Text: ほうら　はやく探したまえ

English.Text: Well then, no time to waste!

Japanese.Text: 待ちくたびれたよ　入りたまえ

English.Text: Better late than never, I suppose. Come in.

Japanese.Text: ぐう……ぐう……

English.Text: Zzz...

Japanese.Text: ぐう……ぐう……

English.Text: Zzz... Hngh!

Japanese.Text:
ああ　そういえば
ここは立ち入り禁止区域だった

English.Text: Oh, how forgetful of me. This area is off-limits to any unauthorized personnel.

Japanese.Text: 手に負えなくなった失敗作を保管していてね

English.Text: It's where I've been keeping a rather unruly failure.

Japanese.Text: イヤァーーー！
では失敗作の後始末　よろしく頼んだよ

English.Text:
And so, I'm afraid you'll have to dispose of it.
Try not to die!

Japanese.Text:
どんなもんや！
ネコなめたらあきませんで～

English.Text: Ha ha! That deserves a wee round of applause!

Japanese.Text: ふぎゃああ！？
こんなん　聞いてませんわ

English.Text: I wasnae built for this kind of thing...

Japanese.Text:
宝条の野郎　今度会ったら
あのメガネ　顔面に埋めてやる

English.Text: That smug asshole. Next time I see him, I'm rammin' my fist right through his face!

Japanese.Text: 手伝うだろ？

English.Text: Agreed?

Japanese.Text: よろこんで

English.Text: Agreed!

Japanese.Text: 上に向かいましょか　はよ端末を探さんと

English.Text: We'd best get going. The terminal's waiting.

Japanese.Text: ご苦労　諸君

English.Text: Excellent work dispatching that fiend.

Japanese.Text: おかげで屋敷がすこしだけ綺麗になったよ

English.Text:
Thanks to you, the manor is a little more
neat and tidy.

Japanese.Text:
さて　保管していた失敗作も片付いたことだし
私もこれで　お役御免だな

English.Text: All well-earned praise aside, since that nettlesome test subject is finally out of my hair, I have no further reason to remain here.

Japanese.Text:
楽しませてもらったよ
では　またどこかで

English.Text:
It's been nothing if not entertaining.
Until we meet again, exterminators.

Japanese.Text: あれ～　なんかお疲れ気味？

English.Text: Well, well, well! Look who the cat dragged in.

Japanese.Text: おかえり

English.Text: Hey there.

Japanese.Text: ただいま

English.Text: So!

Japanese.Text: 端末は見つかった？

English.Text: Find that terminal?

Japanese.Text: まだだ　色々あってな

English.Text: Let's just say we...got a little sidetracked.

Japanese.Text:
捜索を再開しましょ
モタモタしてられませんわ

English.Text:
Well, we can but try again.
No sense stewin' on past mistakes!

Japanese.Text: そう……だな

English.Text: Uh...right.

Japanese.Text: ちょっと　すんません

English.Text: Pardon me.

Japanese.Text: 棺桶……ですやろか？

English.Text: Décor's a bit...grim, no?

Japanese.Text: 私を悪夢から呼び起こすのは

English.Text: Who dares disturb my slumber?

Japanese.Text: 誰だ？

English.Text: Well?

Japanese.Text: あんたこそ　何者だ？

English.Text: Doesn't matter. Who are you?

Japanese.Text: ヴィンセント・ヴァレンタイン

English.Text: Vincent Valentine.

Japanese.Text: 私は……
ここの警備員だ

English.Text: security.

Japanese.Text: 見ない顔だな

English.Text: Why're you here?

Japanese.Text: なんのようだ？

English.Text: Be brief.

Japanese.Text: 端末を借りたい

English.Text: Your terminal.

Japanese.Text: カードキーを

English.Text: Keycard.

Japanese.Text: どぞ

English.Text: There.

Japanese.Text: なるほど

English.Text: Hmph.

Japanese.Text: 端末の使用権限はあるようだ

English.Text: You have the authorization, at least.

Japanese.Text: ほな

English.Text: Great.

Japanese.Text:
しかし　困ったことに
おまえはムラサキではない

English.Text: Though you're clearly not Murasaki.

Japanese.Text: ムラサキはどうした？

English.Text: Explain yourself.

Japanese.Text:
たしかに　カードキーは別の人のモンですけど
急ぎで調べなアカン情報があるんですわ

English.Text: Och, it's a bit of a long story, and we'd love to tell you all about it, but there's somethin' we really need to look up first.

Japanese.Text: 敵に先を越されるワケにはいかんのです！

English.Text: Can't go lettin' our foe win the information war, eh?

Japanese.Text: 敵……おまえの言う敵とは？

English.Text:
Your "foe"?
And who might that be?

Japanese.Text: 神羅

English.Text: Shinra.

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　ちゃいますやろ！

English.Text: "Foe-avorite," don't you mean!

Japanese.Text: ウータイ

English.Text: Wutai.

Japanese.Text: ちょっと　ど～ゆ～つもり？

English.Text: Excuse me? What's that supposed to mean?

Japanese.Text: 冗談だ

English.Text: Kidding.

Japanese.Text: 俺たちの敵は　かつて英雄と呼ばれた男

English.Text:
A man who many people─myself included─
once called a hero:

Japanese.Text: セフィロスだ

English.Text: Sephiroth.

Japanese.Text:
やつは　星を滅ぼすほどの
強大な力を手に入れようとしている

English.Text: He's insane. And he's after something so powerful, it could destroy the planet─unless we stop him.

Japanese.Text: なるほど

English.Text: I see.

Japanese.Text: どうやら　私の罪がまたひとつ増えたようだ

English.Text: Then I've one more sin to atone for.

Japanese.Text: 部屋のロックは解除しておいた

English.Text: The room is unlocked.

Japanese.Text: あとはご自由に　ムラサキ課長

English.Text: Use it as you see fit...Mr. Murasaki.

Japanese.Text: 行っていいってこと？

English.Text: Don't mind if we do, I guess.

Japanese.Text: ほかのものにはさわるなよ

English.Text: Touch nothing but the terminal.

Japanese.Text: 眠らせてくれ

English.Text: Let me sleep.

Japanese.Text: ありましたわ！

English.Text: There she is!

Japanese.Text: クラウドはん　カードキーありまっか？

English.Text: Cloud, my boy! Still got that keycard?

Japanese.Text:
すぐ終わらせますさかい
ちょ～っと待っててくださいね

English.Text:
Gonna need a bit of time with this.
Might I suggest a spot of recon?

Japanese.Text:
この端末　えらい旧式です
難儀しますなあ

English.Text: This thing's an antique! But gimme a few more minutes and I'll find what we're after.

Japanese.Text: あんま急かさんといてください

English.Text: You cannae rush a genius, after all!

Japanese.Text: あっ……！

English.Text: Hng...!

Japanese.Text: うっ……！

English.Text: Urg...!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　大丈夫？

English.Text: Cloud? Hey, Cloud?

Japanese.Text: どうしたの？

English.Text: What's wrong?

Japanese.Text: もうすこし……

English.Text: Nearly...there.

Japanese.Text: Ｓ皮膚より採取……

English.Text: A small sample of S tissue...

Japanese.Text: Ｓ頭髪より採取……

English.Text: a single strand of S hair...

Japanese.Text: Ｓ血液より採取……

English.Text: and a few drops of S blood.

Japanese.Text: クラウド　もう出よう

English.Text: Cloud, let's get out of here.

Japanese.Text: なに？

English.Text: Oh no.

Japanese.Text: その部屋への立ち入りを許可した覚えはない

English.Text: I don't recall giving you permission to go in there.

Japanese.Text: ちょっとした手違いですわ！

English.Text: Och, it was an honest mistake!

Japanese.Text: 堪忍して――

English.Text: We didn't mean any h─

Japanese.Text: はなして　やめて　見逃して～！

English.Text: Don't hurt me! Please! I can explain!

Japanese.Text: はなせ

English.Text: Drop him.

Japanese.Text: 道理はどちらにある

English.Text: Why should I?

Japanese.Text: 私か　おまえか

English.Text: He's trespassing. Like you.

Japanese.Text: 悪いが　色々あってイライラしている

English.Text: Save it. I've had a pretty shit day.

Japanese.Text: 奇遇だな　私もだ

English.Text: What a coincidence... So have I.

Japanese.Text: バケモノめ！

English.Text: Ya damn freak!

Japanese.Text: 来るぞ！

English.Text: C'mon!

Japanese.Text: ヴィンセントはん

English.Text: I know your story.

Japanese.Text: 元タークスの……ヴィンセント・ヴァレンタイン

English.Text: Vincent Valentine. Former Turk.

Japanese.Text: 端末で調べさせてもらいました

English.Text: Stumbled on your file in the company database.

Japanese.Text:
こんなところで　くすぶっている理由
セフィロスと関係あるんとちゃいますか？

English.Text: There's a reason you're alone in the dark down here. And that reason has something to do with Sephiroth, am I right?

Japanese.Text: 答える義理はない

English.Text: That's none of your business.

Japanese.Text: よかったら　いっしょに行きませんか

English.Text: I only ask because you might want to come with us.

Japanese.Text:
セフィロスの生死に関しては
正直　ボクも半信半疑ですけど

English.Text: I don't know whether Sephiroth is dead or alive or somethin' in between...

Japanese.Text:
この人たちについていけば
なんや　わかるかもしれません

English.Text:
but I do know that if I stick with this lot,
I'll find out one way or another.

Japanese.Text: このままで　いいんですか？

English.Text: Is this how you want your story to end?

Japanese.Text: 出ていけ　立ち去れ

English.Text: Get out... Now.

Japanese.Text: ほな　行きましょか

English.Text: That'll be our way out, then.

Japanese.Text: 神殿の場所はわかりましたし　長居は無用ですわ

English.Text:
Now we know where the temple is,
let's not bother the man.

Japanese.Text: ぼーっとしてんな　行くぞ

English.Text: Hey, space cadet. C'mon.

Japanese.Text: ここには秘密のマテリアとかないの～？

English.Text: Think there might be top secret materia hidden somewhere here?

Japanese.Text: そればっかか　おまえは！

English.Text: That all you ever think about?

Japanese.Text: あったりまえじゃん　だいたいさ～

English.Text: Well, excuse me for tryin' to be helpful!

Japanese.Text: さあ　いよいよ神殿だよ

English.Text: Okay! Next stop: the temple!

Japanese.Text:
なにがなんでも
黒マテリア　いただくからね

English.Text: Hear that, black materia? I'm comin' for ya!

Japanese.Text: このままじゃ　アタシのメンツまるつぶれ！

English.Text: Oh, man! My rep's gonna go through the roof!

Japanese.Text: おまえのメンツなんて知るか

English.Text: Well, it ain't like it could go down.

Japanese.Text: 神殿　どこなの？

English.Text: So...where is it?

Japanese.Text: あ～っと　それなんですが

English.Text: Aye, about that...

Japanese.Text:
まさか　この期に及んで
わからねえとか言い出すんじゃ

English.Text:
What's the matter?
You ain't been bluffin' this whole time, have ya?

Japanese.Text: いやいや　場所はわかったんですが　その……

English.Text:
No, that's not it. We could go there right now
if you really wanted.

Japanese.Text: 先に　ゴールドソーサーに寄ってもらえまへんか？

English.Text:
But before that, would you mind a quick trip
to the Saucer?

Japanese.Text: はあ？　なんでよ！

English.Text: What!? Why would we wanna go there!?

Japanese.Text:
神殿に入るためには　『キーストーン』っちゅー
カギが必要なんですが

English.Text: To even set foot inside the temple, we'll need to get our hands on a relic called the keystone.

Japanese.Text: かれこれ２０年　行方知れずらしいんですわ

English.Text: Trouble is, it's been missin' for nigh on twenty years.

Japanese.Text: ただ　最後にあった場所が……

English.Text: So, any guesses as to where it was last seen?

Japanese.Text: ゴールドソーサーなのか

English.Text: The Gold Saucer...

Japanese.Text:
確率は半々です
でも　ほかに手がかりがありません

English.Text:
I know... It's a stretch, no denying that...
but it's the only lead I've got.

Japanese.Text: 信じるぞ　ケット・シー

English.Text: Then let's follow it. We trust you.

Japanese.Text: おおきに　ありがとうございます！

English.Text: You do? Thank you!

Japanese.Text: おおきに　おおきに！

English.Text: Thank you, thank you!

Japanese.Text: しゃあねえ　仕度ができたら出発だ！

English.Text:
Well, if we gotta...
Once we're good, let's get a move on.

Japanese.Text: なんだあ？

English.Text: What's this?

Japanese.Text: うう……あ……

English.Text: Urnh...

Japanese.Text: 待たせたな　マーイフレンド！

English.Text: Sorry I'm so late to the party, my friend!

Japanese.Text: ようやく再会できた

English.Text: Our long-awaited reunion.

Japanese.Text: わたし　捕まらないよ？

English.Text: I'm not going with you, so back off!

Japanese.Text: ノー　ノー　ノー

English.Text: You misunderstand.

Japanese.Text:
これは個人的な戦い
ボスにばれたら　ペナルティダ～イ！

English.Text: I'm defying my boss to be here─'cause I've got a hunger that cannot be denied!

Japanese.Text: クラウド　俺は黒マテリアが欲しい

English.Text: Cloud. Bring me the black materia.

Japanese.Text: キミに会いたい一心で　ここまで来たんだ

English.Text: My desire to see you has driven me on.

Japanese.Text: こんなことまでトップスピードとはね

English.Text: That's what I get for redlining the old engine...

Japanese.Text:
さあ　ラストダンスを楽しもう
マイフレンドー！

English.Text:
Alright, my friend! It's the final lap, so let's gun it,
one last time!

Japanese.Text: ここは　まかせろ！

English.Text: He's mine!

Japanese.Text: どうした？

English.Text: You okay?

Japanese.Text: これは真剣勝負　情けは無用だろ？

English.Text: Uh-uh-uh... I won't have your pity. This is a race, remember?

Japanese.Text: さあ　命を燃やそうか　クラウド！

English.Text: Come on, Cloud. We're on the homestretch!

Japanese.Text: 厄介だなあ　劣化は……　マイ……フレ――

English.Text: There's no escaping...the degradation...my...friend...

Japanese.Text: くろ……まてりあ……

English.Text: Black...materia...

Japanese.Text: 黒マテリアは　誰にも渡さないよ！

English.Text: Dream on! That materia's mine!

Japanese.Text: 厄介だなあ　劣化は……

English.Text: There's no escaping...the degradation...

Japanese.Text: だいじょうぶだよ　クラウドは

English.Text: That won't happen to you. Don't worry.

Japanese.Text: うん　大丈夫

English.Text: Yeah, she's right.

Japanese.Text: クラウドは大丈夫

English.Text: You're gonna be just fine.

Japanese.Text:
行こうぜ
キンピカの楽園　もういちどだ

English.Text: C'mon. The gilded saucer awaits. And the keystone.

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
黒マントの集団から　微弱ながら
エンシェントマターの反応を観測しました

English.Text: I'm picking up protorelic energy signals from a group of robed individuals.

Japanese.Text: どういうことだ

English.Text: You are?

Japanese.Text: 詳細は不明です　というわけで――

English.Text: Indeed. Though I'm unable to ascertain why.

Japanese.Text: 調べればいいのか

English.Text: So...check it out?

Japanese.Text: 話が早くて　助かります！

English.Text: How very astute of you!

Japanese.Text:
黒マントのみなさんは　休みをはさみつつ
ゆっくりと　どこかへ向かっているようです

English.Text: While they're not in any obvious hurry, they do appear to be heading toward a specific location.

Japanese.Text:
お忙しいかと思いますが　手があきましたら
追跡調査をお願いします！

English.Text: Should you find the time, I ask that you track their movements─see where it is they're going.

Japanese.Text: ついていけばいいんだよね？

English.Text: We're just trailing 'em...?

Japanese.Text:
ああ　なにか目的があるはずだ
それを確かめる

English.Text:
You heard Chadley. That's the plan.
Least till they get to wherever they're going.

Japanese.Text: ふわ～あ……

English.Text: Haaawn...nmm...

Japanese.Text: 眠いの～？

English.Text: Gettin' sleepy, are we?

Japanese.Text: 歩くのが遅すぎるよ

English.Text: With how slow they walk? Who wouldn't?

Japanese.Text: そのへんを走りまわってこい

English.Text: Can run on ahead and play scout.

Japanese.Text: はぐれないよ～に！

English.Text: But stay where we can see you!

Japanese.Text:
はあ　谷からこっち
オイラの扱いが雑だよね

English.Text: Ever since we left the vale... Never shoulda dropped the intellectual shtick.

Japanese.Text: うう……あ……

English.Text: Urng... Argh...

Japanese.Text: 待て

English.Text: Wait.

Japanese.Text: 世話が焼けるね

English.Text: Can these guys do anything?

Japanese.Text: ほとんどは　宝条の犠牲者だ

English.Text: Hojo made 'em this way, remember?

Japanese.Text: そうだね　ごめん

English.Text: Right... Sorry.

Japanese.Text:
つきっきりってわけにはいかないよ
守りきれるかな？

English.Text: Not to be a downer, but there's no way we can save 'em from everything.

Japanese.Text: やれるだけやるさ

English.Text: We'll do what we can.

Japanese.Text: あの人たち　なに考えてるんだろうね

English.Text: Hey, so...what kinda stuff you think they're thinking about?

Japanese.Text:
黒マント？
いまは　エンシェントマターのことじゃないかな

English.Text: The black robes? I dunno... The protorelic maybe?

Japanese.Text:
黒マント自身は　なにも考えていないと思う
たぶん　そのほうがいい

English.Text: I doubt they're lucid enough to even know what they're doing. Probably better that way.

Japanese.Text: そうだね　ひどい目にあうもんね

English.Text: Sad, but true. I'll bet they've seen some things...

Japanese.Text: 本能で動く動物に近いのかな

English.Text: Reduced to their instincts...like animals.

Japanese.Text: 神羅　ヒトデナシだよね

English.Text: Man... Screw Shinra.

Japanese.Text: 間違いないな

English.Text: Damn right.

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
黒マントさんたちが　また動きはじめました
引き続き　追跡をお願いします

English.Text: Our robed friends are on the move again. If time allows, I would like you to resume your pursuit.

Japanese.Text:
しかし　クラウドさんたちが戻ってくると
黒マントさんたちが活発化するようなのですが

English.Text: They seem to become more active when you and the others approach them, for reasons I have yet to ascertain...

Japanese.Text: なにか関係があるのでしょうか

English.Text: One of their many mysteries indeed...

Japanese.Text:
黒マントさんたちが再び動きはじめました
クラウドさん　追跡調査をお願いします！

English.Text: The robed individuals have resumed their travels. I'd like you to track them if you have the time.

Japanese.Text: あれは……

English.Text: What's that?

Japanese.Text:
神羅カンパニーの水質試験場ですね
魔晄採掘による水への影響を調べていたようです

English.Text: A Shinra testing facility. They were looking into mako-extraction's effects on the region's water supply.

Japanese.Text: 結果は？

English.Text: And?

Japanese.Text:
『水質への影響は見られない』
これが公式発表です

English.Text: And they found that there were none. Or so the official statement claimed.

Japanese.Text: 信じられな～い！

English.Text: Oh, no need to worry then!

Japanese.Text: いちおう　お知らせしておきますと

English.Text: If I may put your minds at ease...

Japanese.Text:
ニブルヘイム村の給水塔と水道管には
当初から最新式の浄水装置が内蔵されています

English.Text: both Nibelheim's water tower and pipe network utilized filtration devices that were state-of-the-art for the time.

Japanese.Text:
悪影響の証拠となるデータは見つかりませんから
なんとも言えませんけど

English.Text: Furthermore, there was no evidence that water quality was impacted by the reactor.

Japanese.Text:
浄水装置のおかげで
影響が出なかったとも考えられますね

English.Text: The filters likely mitigated any deleterious effects.

Japanese.Text: 俺は　その水を飲んで育った

English.Text: Well, I grew up drinking that water...

Japanese.Text: だから　性格がそんななんだ！

English.Text: That certainly explains a lot.

Japanese.Text: 証拠が出ちゃったね

English.Text: Sure those filters worked?

Japanese.Text: 消されるかもな

English.Text: You tell me.

Japanese.Text: えっ　廃墟？

English.Text: Yeesh... What a mess.

Japanese.Text: うう……う……

English.Text: Urgh... Ungh...

Japanese.Text: 中に入りたいんだね

English.Text: Seems like they wanna go inside...

Japanese.Text: ぐぅ……！

English.Text: Urg...!

Japanese.Text: もう　勝手に進むから～

English.Text: Stop running off on your own already!

Japanese.Text: 来るぞ！

English.Text: Heads up!

Japanese.Text: それって　エンシェントマター？

English.Text: So, is that our proto-majig?

Japanese.Text: ああ　カケラだな

English.Text: Part of one, looks like.

Japanese.Text:
どうやら　先ほどのモンスターの
体内にあったようです

English.Text: A fiend must have ingested the fragment by mistake.

Japanese.Text: どうりで　反応が観測できないわけです

English.Text: Little wonder I was unable to locate it.

Japanese.Text:
ほかのカケラも
モンスターが所持している可能性があります

English.Text:
I suspect other creatures are in possession
of the remainder.

Japanese.Text: どうやって探す？

English.Text: So what now?

Japanese.Text:
黒マントさんに案内してもらうというのは
どうでしょう？

English.Text:
Your hooded friends may well lead us
to other fragments.

Japanese.Text: おっと！

English.Text: Whoa there.

Japanese.Text: 腕の数字　ある人とない人がいるね

English.Text: Hey, you notice? Only some of 'em have number tats.

Japanese.Text: ああ

English.Text: Huh...

Japanese.Text: ニブルヘイムで療養されている方には

English.Text: Based on what I've seen in Nibelheim...

Japanese.Text:
魔晄中毒者や　神羅による実験の参加者など
様々な出自の方がいらっしゃいます

English.Text: victims of mako poisoning─and subjects of Shinra experiments─make up the majority of their number.

Japanese.Text: ナンバーのありなしは　それに関係するのかと

English.Text: The presence─or lack─of tattoos could be a clue.

Japanese.Text: 数字で識別なんて　暴力だよ

English.Text: No one should be marked like cattle─no one.

Japanese.Text: だね

English.Text: For real.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん　この近くで
新たな黒マントさんたちを発見しました

English.Text:
Cloud─I've located another group
not far from your location.

Japanese.Text:
集団で行動しているようです
引き続き　追跡調査をお願いします！

English.Text: I ask that you accompany them to their objective. They may lead us to yet another fragment!

Japanese.Text: 見て　ついてきてる

English.Text: Uh, I think we got fans.

Japanese.Text: エンシェントマター狙いだよ

English.Text: They're after the protorelic too.

Japanese.Text: 放っておこう

English.Text: Ignore 'em.

Japanese.Text: 見つけた！

English.Text: Found 'em!

Japanese.Text: 今度は　どこに行くんだろ？

English.Text: Where d'ya think these ones're off to?

Japanese.Text: エンシェントマターのところだね

English.Text: My guess? The protorelic.

Japanese.Text: う～ん　切ないなあ

English.Text: I gotta say, this is really bumming me out.

Japanese.Text: なにが？

English.Text: What is?

Japanese.Text:
黒マントの人たちは
みんな　似たようなニオイがするんだ

English.Text: These black robes─they all smell the same, more or less...

Japanese.Text: 魔晄の影響かもな

English.Text: 'Cause of the mako, you think?

Japanese.Text:
そうかも　でも
それよりも　もっと悲しいニオイだよ

English.Text: Could be, but I doubt it. Their scent is...I dunno─heavier?

Japanese.Text:
オイラにとって
ニオイは　そのひとの大事な個性だよ

English.Text: To me, a person's scent is one of their most defining features.

Japanese.Text: それがいっしょになっちゃうのは　悲しいな

English.Text: But all these guys smell almost identical.

Japanese.Text: ナナキ　俺のニオイはどうだ？

English.Text: Hey... What do I smell like?

Japanese.Text: クラウドは　クラウドのニオイだね

English.Text: You smell like you. Simple as that.

Japanese.Text: アタシは？

English.Text: And me?

Japanese.Text: えっ　なに　なんで黙るの！

English.Text: What...? What!? Do I smell like rotten eggs or something!?

Japanese.Text: 黒マント～　追いかけ～るアタシ～

English.Text: Following those guys to wherever they lead♪

Japanese.Text: アタシ追いかける～　黒～マント～

English.Text: Oh, robed guys, you must be cooking underneath those robes♪

Japanese.Text:
うわ～……
黒マント　暑そうだよね

English.Text: Yeah... All that black's gotta be stifling.

Japanese.Text:
うん　着たことあるけど
けっこー暑いよ

English.Text: Oh, it is─trust and believe. Hotter than a friggin' oven.

Japanese.Text:
そんな格好で
砂漠も歩いてきたんだよね　すごいね

English.Text: I still can't believe they managed to cross the desert in those getups. Pretty crazy.

Japanese.Text: 脱落した者も多いはずだ

English.Text: Some did. Not all.

Japanese.Text: ユフィに会う前も　かなり見かけたよね

English.Text: We ran into a bunch before you joined, Yuffie.

Japanese.Text: そういえば　アタシもミッドガルで見たよ

English.Text: In Midgar? I saw my fair share when I was there too.

Japanese.Text: というか　最初に会ったのがそうだったな

English.Text: Never came across 'em before that though, now that I think about it...

Japanese.Text: 俺の隣人もそうだったな

English.Text: Lived next to one for a bit.

Japanese.Text: えっ　なに　どういうこと？

English.Text: Huh? Whaddya think they're pointin' at?

Japanese.Text: 港の下に潜水艦用のドックがある

English.Text:
There's a submarine dock beneath the harbor.
Maybe that.

Japanese.Text: そこにエンシェントマターがあるのかな

English.Text: I betcha that's where we'll find the protorelic.

Japanese.Text: なに　アタシたちに命令してんの？

English.Text: Oh, I see. Make us go and fish it out...

Japanese.Text: 海側からドックの中に入れるはずだ

English.Text: Simplest way inside would be by sea...

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん！

English.Text: Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
海を渡るなら　この地域に生息する
海チョコボの力が必要です

English.Text: If you intend to cross the water, you'll need the help of a unique chocobo living in the region.

Japanese.Text:
このあたりの人里離れた場所に
伝説のチョコボ仙人が住んでると言います

English.Text: And it just so happens a reclusive chocobo master is said to reside somewhere nearby...

Japanese.Text: いちど　訪ねてみてはいかがでしょう

English.Text: They're sure to know the bird's whereabouts.

Japanese.Text: シレナに乗れば行けそうだね

English.Text: Then Selena's got us covered!

Japanese.Text: うわ　ここにもいる！

English.Text: Dang! They're in here too?
Arg... Ah...!

Japanese.Text: ダメ！

English.Text: Stop!

Japanese.Text: ねえ　クラウド

English.Text: Hey...Cloud?

Japanese.Text: 黒マントとセフィロスは無関係じゃない

English.Text: These guys and Sephiroth are related somehow...

Japanese.Text:
それどころか　すっごく関係が深い
そうだよね？

English.Text: Like, connected on some really weird, deep level...right?

Japanese.Text: だろうな

English.Text: Seems so.

Japanese.Text: そうなの？

English.Text: "Seems so"?

Japanese.Text:
証拠とまでは言わないが
そう信じるべき理由がいくつかある

English.Text: I don't have proof─just a hunch. But the more I see the more I know I'm right.

Japanese.Text: はやく終わらせてあげないとね　彼らのために

English.Text: Just one more reason why we gotta put a stop to that crazy bastard.

Japanese.Text: あっ　失礼しました

English.Text: Oh! I didn't mean to startle you.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントさんたちが動きはじめましたので
いちはやくお伝えしようかと

English.Text: I simply wanted to inform you that I have located more robed individuals.

Japanese.Text: わかった　どこへ行けばいい？

English.Text: Copy. Send us the coordinates.

Japanese.Text: はい　こちらです！

English.Text: Of course, right away!

Japanese.Text: いたいた！

English.Text: There they are!

Japanese.Text: う……ああああ……！

English.Text: Urgh... Arrrgh!

Japanese.Text: 待って　なにか変だよ

English.Text: Wait. Something's not right.

Japanese.Text: あいつら　宝条の！

English.Text: Those monsters─they're Hojo's!

Japanese.Text: 来るぞ！

English.Text: Shit!

Japanese.Text:
宝条博士のモンスターが
どうして……まさか

English.Text: What could his experiments be doing in a place like this? Unless... No!

Japanese.Text:
これはこれは　またおそろいで
我が愛しの実験体よ

English.Text:
Well now... This I did not expect.
My precious specimens...

Japanese.Text: それと――

English.Text: and you─

Japanese.Text: チャドリー

English.Text: Chadley.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　型式番号はＣＤＡ－６
いや……７だったかな？

English.Text:
Model number CDA-6, was it?
Or...seven, perhaps?

Japanese.Text: いち　に　さん　し　ご　ろく……と

English.Text: One, two, three, four, five, six... Aha.

Japanese.Text: ふむ　やはり７だ

English.Text: Yes, lucky number seven.

Japanese.Text:
見ないと思ったら
管理プログラムを解いたのか

English.Text: You and your brothers are just full of surprises, aren't you?

Japanese.Text:
いいぞ　頭の中を見せておくれ
チャドリー？

English.Text: Don't be shy now. Open up and let me see what makes you tick. There's a good boy...

Japanese.Text: どうした？

English.Text: What is it?

Japanese.Text: いえ……問題ありません

English.Text: Nothing... I'm fine.

Japanese.Text: ねえ！

English.Text: Look!

Japanese.Text:
黒マントさんたちが動きはじめました
引き続き　追跡をお願いします

English.Text: It seems our robed friends are on the move again. You'd best follow closely behind.

Japanese.Text:
ほかにも　宝条博士のモンスターがいる
可能性が高いです

English.Text: I would hate for any of them to run afoul of one of Hojo's experiments.

Japanese.Text: みなさん　くれぐれも気をつけてください

English.Text: Please... Keep them from harm.

Japanese.Text: あれ……？

English.Text: Hey...

Japanese.Text: 黒マントたち　いなくなったね

English.Text: That group from before. Where'd they go?

Japanese.Text: モンスターに襲われたか　融合したか

English.Text: Killed by fiends, maybe... Or forced to fuse with 'em.

Japanese.Text: 許せないよ

English.Text: Hojo's dead.

Japanese.Text: この上は　なんだろうね

English.Text: So, you got any idea what's up here?

Japanese.Text:
行ったことはないが
灯台と関連する施設があるはずだ

English.Text: Old lighthouse, among other things. Never checked it out myself though.

Japanese.Text: 茶屋　あるかな？

English.Text: I wonder if there's a tearoom!

Japanese.Text: 茶屋？

English.Text: A what?

Japanese.Text:
えっ　なに　変？
ウータイじゃあたりまえにあるよ

English.Text: A tearoom! In Wutai, ya can't throw a ninja star without hitting at least a couple, ya know.

Japanese.Text: お茶は飲み放題だけど　お菓子が高いの

English.Text: Tea's always free! The food on the other hand... That's how they getcha.

Japanese.Text:
そうか　でも残念だな
たぶん……ないだろう

English.Text: That so? Well...I don't think we're gonna find one here...or anywhere else nearby.

Japanese.Text: ないか～

English.Text: Boo!

Japanese.Text: 先に入って　安全を確認しておこう

English.Text: We should go on ahead─make sure it's safe.

Japanese.Text: うわ　出た！

English.Text: Beastie─twelve o'clock!

Japanese.Text: ううう……

English.Text: Uhrrr...

Japanese.Text: なんか　増えてない？

English.Text: Did they multiply?

Japanese.Text: ああ……あ……

English.Text: Ragh... Urg...

Japanese.Text: ブロード？

English.Text: Broden?

Japanese.Text: おい……しっかりしろ　おい！

English.Text: Broden! Hey! Snap out of it!

Japanese.Text: カームで助けてくれた人だよね

English.Text: Wait... The guy from Kalm!?

Japanese.Text: 魔晄中毒？

English.Text: Is he mako poisoned?

Japanese.Text: わからない

English.Text: I don't know.

Japanese.Text: いや　元ソルジャーだ

English.Text: No...he's a former SOLDIER.

Japanese.Text: 呼んで……いる

English.Text: It calls...to me.

Japanese.Text: 行かない　と……

English.Text: I...must answer.

Japanese.Text: リ……ユニ……オン……

English.Text: The...the reunion...

Japanese.Text: 行こう

English.Text: It's time...

Japanese.Text: リ……ユニ……オン……

English.Text: Re...u...nion...

Japanese.Text: あの人も　ニブルヘイムにいたのかな

English.Text:
Do you think he was gettin' treatment
in Nibelheim too?

Japanese.Text: クラウド？

English.Text: You good?

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん！

English.Text: Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
黒マントのみなさんが
これまでにない大規模な移動を開始しました

English.Text:
I've found another gathering of these individuals─
the largest yet.

Japanese.Text:
どうやら　海岸へと向かっているようです
至急　調査をお願いします

English.Text: It would appear that they're headed for the coastline. Do you think you could investigate for me?

Japanese.Text: わかった

English.Text: Will do.

Japanese.Text: 行こう……行かないと

English.Text: It's time... Time we checked it out.

Japanese.Text: ちょっ……あれ　なにしてんの？

English.Text: What in the─ What're they doing!?

Japanese.Text: 海を渡る気だ

English.Text: Trying to cross the water.

Japanese.Text: 急ごう

English.Text: C'mon.

Japanese.Text: ああ……！

English.Text: Why...?

Japanese.Text: あの人たちなら行けるのかも

English.Text: I mean, they might make it.

Japanese.Text: ああ　もう人間ではないのかもな

English.Text: Maybe... Guys're nothing if not tenacious.

Japanese.Text: でも　助けるんでしょ？

English.Text: Where are they even trying to go?

Japanese.Text: あの島だ　あそこにいる

English.Text: That island. That's where they're being called.

Japanese.Text: えっ　なんでわかんの？

English.Text: What? How d'you know that?

Japanese.Text: 勘としか言えない

English.Text: Got a feeling...is all.

Japanese.Text: いいよ　あの島へ行ってみよう

English.Text: That's good enough for me. Let's check it out.

Japanese.Text: うわ　集まってる

English.Text: Whoa... There's so many of 'em!

Japanese.Text: あっちに行けってこと？

English.Text: You want us to go that way?

Japanese.Text: なにして――

English.Text: What're they─

Japanese.Text: おおおお……！

English.Text: Ahhhr...

Japanese.Text: おっとっとっと！

English.Text: Whoa...uh...hey...!?

Japanese.Text: どうなってんの？

English.Text: What is this?

Japanese.Text: 異界の迷い人か

English.Text: A wayward soul?

Japanese.Text: おまえにまかせよう

English.Text: He's all yours.

Japanese.Text: 我を引きずり出すとは　この無礼者！

English.Text: Summoned by churls? How dare you!

Japanese.Text:
その首　叩き斬ってやるから
そこにひざまずけ！

English.Text: For this outrage, I demand satisfaction!

Japanese.Text: 良きかな良きかな　興が乗ってきたわ！

English.Text: Rousing─inspiring even! I must fight in earnest!

Japanese.Text: って……あら？

English.Text: ...Hm? Wait.

Japanese.Text: 残念無念　これまでか

English.Text: The curtain has fallen...and I depart the stage.

Japanese.Text: 黒マテリアを探せ　クラウド

English.Text: Find me the black materia, Cloud.

Japanese.Text: えっ　クラウド？

English.Text: Huh? Cloud!?

Japanese.Text: グリングリン　ここでなにをしている？

English.Text: Billy? What are you doing out here?

Japanese.Text: うん……

English.Text: Um...

Japanese.Text:
ゴールドソーサーでレースに挑戦してたんだけど
ちょっと　スランプみたいで

English.Text:
I haven't had much luck at the racetrack lately...
Not the good kind, that's for sure.

Japanese.Text: チョコボ修行にきたんだ

English.Text: So I came here to train.

Japanese.Text: 修行？　ここで？

English.Text: Train? Here?

Japanese.Text: 知らないの？

English.Text: You don't know where you are?

Japanese.Text:
ここは　チョコボ界で知らない者はいない
伝説の人物　チョコボ仙人の家だよ

English.Text: This is the home of the chocobo sage! A living legend! Surely you've heard of the man?

Japanese.Text: ほ～ほほ　ワシを呼んだかの

English.Text: Ahahaha! Did someone say "livin' legend"?

Japanese.Text: 大丈夫ですか　仙人！

English.Text: You okay, sir!?

Japanese.Text: ふう　死ぬかと思ったぞい

English.Text: ...I am now. Thought I was a goner.

Japanese.Text:
こんなヘンピなところにやってくる
モノ好きは　だれかいの？

English.Text: Mind tellin' me who you are? Don't get many visitors out here in the boonies.

Japanese.Text:
彼は　クラウド
グリン牧場の騎手をしてもらってます

English.Text: Uh...this is Cloud. He's a jockey for Gramps's ranch.

Japanese.Text: ほ～ん

English.Text: Oh, he is, huh?

Japanese.Text:
ふむ　ならちょーどええ
おまえさんも　手伝っていけ

English.Text: Perfect. Billy here needs some help─you can pick up the poor boy's slack.

Japanese.Text:
今度　『ゴールドカップ』っていう
特別なチョコボレースがあって

English.Text: There's this big race at the Saucer, the Gold Cup, and it's coming up soon.

Japanese.Text:
それに出場するために　仙人から
チョコボ育成の極意を教えてもらってるんだ

English.Text: We gotta get in on that, so I came here to bone up. I'm learnin' all sortsa stuff!

Japanese.Text: ほら！

English.Text: See?

Japanese.Text: ねえ　だまされてるんじゃないの？

English.Text: Hey─tell me you're not buyin' this chocodung.

Japanese.Text:
修行とか言いながら
身のまわりの世話を押しつけるつもりだよ

English.Text: Picking garbage out of a pool isn't training─it's manual labor!

Japanese.Text: ねえ　どう思う？

English.Text: You see it too, right?

Japanese.Text: だよね～

English.Text: So weird!

Japanese.Text: あんた　やめたほうがいいよ

English.Text: C'mon─he's just jerkin' you around!

Japanese.Text: う～ん　たしかに毎日掃除ばかりだけど

English.Text: I suppose I haven't done much 'cept pick up after him...

Japanese.Text:
ただのっていうか
ものすご～く　ジジイだよね

English.Text: Well, doi, he's not a "sage." This guy's like the king of the crazy old coots!

Japanese.Text:
グリンじいちゃんが子供のときには
すでに　じいさんだったって言ってた

English.Text: Dunno about "coot," but Gramps did say he was already old when he was young.

Japanese.Text: ええ～？

English.Text: What!?

Japanese.Text: さすがクラウド　わかってるね

English.Text: If anyone was gonna get it, figures it'd be you!

Japanese.Text: 仙人は　チョコボ育成理論の基礎を作った人で

English.Text: This man right here wrote the book on chocobo rearin'!

Japanese.Text:
現在　一般的に広まっているチョコボは
仙人によって品種改良されたものなんだよ

English.Text: In fact, pretty much all the major breeds maintained these days are products of his techniques!

Japanese.Text:
な～にを　コソコソと話しちょる
すっかり手が止まっとるの～

English.Text: If you can flap your gums, you can move your gams. Now get on back to your trainin'.

Japanese.Text: すいません！

English.Text: Sorry!

Japanese.Text: さて……

English.Text: As for you...

Japanese.Text:
おまえさんには
ワシのチョコボを迎えにいってもらおうかの

English.Text: I know just the thing. One of my chocobos ran off when we put her out to pasture.

Japanese.Text: 遊びにいったまま　帰ってこんのじゃ

English.Text: Need you to find her─bring her back.

Japanese.Text: なぜ　俺が？

English.Text: You're asking me?

Japanese.Text:
名前は　シレナ
波の上を駆け　水を操る海チョコボじゃ

English.Text: Her name is Selena. Ain't your normal chocobo neither─loves the ocean more'n home.

Japanese.Text:
ワシでも手を焼くほど気難しいヤツだからな
せえぜえ　ご機嫌をとるこっちゃ

English.Text: The way she makes rollin' waves look like solid ground... No wonder she thinks she's the bee's knees.

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　ごめん
ぼくのためだと思って　力を貸して

English.Text:
Please, Cloud. Would you mind?
Just...think of it as a favor for me.

Japanese.Text: クラウドにとっては簡単なことだよね？

English.Text: You've got a gift for wranglin' the wild ones!

Japanese.Text: 海チョコボなら　もう捕まえた

English.Text: A bird that runs on water? Already found 'em.

Japanese.Text:
いやはや　にぎやかじゃの～
こんなに人がおるのは　いつぶりじゃ？

English.Text: Haven't had this many visitors in ages. Honestly, I almost forgot what it was like.

Japanese.Text:
まえにも若者が住みついとったが
はて　なんて名だったかの？

English.Text: Last ones were my disciples. Went by... Huh... What were those boys' names again?

Japanese.Text:
はて　おまえさんには
海チョコボの捕獲を頼んだはずじゃが？

English.Text: That's strange... Coulda sworn I asked you to bring me back a certain water-lovin' chocobo.

Japanese.Text: なんか　巻き込んじゃってごめんね

English.Text: Guess we're both "bonin' up" now, huh?

Japanese.Text:
クラウド　仙人の海チョコボは見つかった？
チョコボ探しは　まず足跡からだよ

English.Text: Hey, you find the bird the chocobo sage was talkin' about? If you're havin' trouble, just start by lookin' for tracks.

Japanese.Text:
アタシ　えらそうな師匠って
大キライなんだよね

English.Text: That "sage" is a hack. And trust me, I should know.

Japanese.Text:
くちばっかりで
自分では動かないっしょ　あいつらって

English.Text: His kind're nothin' but hot air, never practicin' what they preach.

Japanese.Text:
それに　アタシたちの声はぜんぜん聞かないの
そんなんだから――

English.Text: You shoulda seen this one loser. The jerk couldn't hear any of us over the sound of his own stupid voice.

Japanese.Text: 誰のことだ

English.Text: Who exactly?

Japanese.Text: アタシのオヤジ！

English.Text: My old man...

Japanese.Text: ふん

English.Text: Heh.

Japanese.Text: 笑い事じゃないんだよ～

English.Text: Excuse you! It's not funny.

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　仙人のチョコボ
あれじゃない？

English.Text: That chocobo over there. It's just gotta be the sage's.

Japanese.Text: シレナだったな

English.Text: That's Selena.

Japanese.Text: 気難しい性格だって言ってたし　慎重にね

English.Text: Bird sounded kind of, uh, temperamental, so let's not rush this!

Japanese.Text: クエッ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Japanese.Text:
いま　クラウド選手が
気難しいと言われるチョコボを難なく捕獲！

English.Text: Wow! Not even the feisty Selena was a challenge for our star wrangler, Cloud!

Japanese.Text: すごいね～　いよっ！

English.Text: How does he do it, folks!?

Japanese.Text:
いま　クラウド選手が
気難しいと言われるチョコボをやっとのことで捕獲

English.Text: Impressive work by Cloud today! Though it wasn't easy, he finally brought the feisty Selena to heel!

Japanese.Text: なんとか　メンツを保ちました～！

English.Text: Lucky for him, because more attempts would have been humiliating!

Japanese.Text: ほんじゃ　報告に戻りますか

English.Text: Let's get her back to ol' sageykins, shall we?

Japanese.Text: よかった　シレナを捕まえたんだね

English.Text: Hey! Nice goin', catchin' Selena.

Japanese.Text: 仙人が待ちわびてるよ

English.Text: Sage is gonna be real pleased.

Japanese.Text: おお　シレナ！

English.Text: There you are, Selena!

Japanese.Text:
おまえさん　こいつを連れ帰るとは
なかなか見どころがある
