English.Text:
Well, I underestimated ya.
Takes real skill to tame this girl.

Japanese.Text:
ひょっとすると　ええと
あれじゃ……なんだ？

English.Text: Skills like those of... Hold on... I know this... I do.

Japanese.Text: あいつらの名前が出てこんわい！

English.Text: Why can't I remember!?

Japanese.Text: ぐう～　くやしい！

English.Text: Dammit! This is gonna bother me all day!

Japanese.Text:
ああ　思い出した
サムとリングリン！

English.Text: Aha! There we go! It was Sam and Will!

Japanese.Text: えっ？

English.Text: What?

Japanese.Text: ワシの　最高の弟子たちじゃ

English.Text: They were far and away my best disciples.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドよ　おまえさんは
ふたりと肩を並べるほどの逸材かもしれんぞ

English.Text: As I was sayin'. You, Cloud? You may well become as talented a trainer as them one day.

Japanese.Text:
仙人　教えてください
そのサムのこと　教えてください！

English.Text: Did I hear you right!? "Sam"? You gotta tell me everything you know about him!

Japanese.Text: やや　やめんか！

English.Text: You're gonna give me whiplash, son!

Japanese.Text:
仙人の弟子だったサムは
ミッドガルの　チョコボ・サムですよね

English.Text:
The "Sam" guy you taught...
You mean "Chocobo Sam" out of Midgar?

Japanese.Text: そのはずだが　それがどうした

English.Text: I do, but...why d'you wanna know?

Japanese.Text:
リングリンは　ぼくの父です
ぼくは　リングリンの息子なんです

English.Text: Because me and him, we got history. Y'see...I'm Will's son.

Japanese.Text: ほお……

English.Text: Well, don't that beat all...

Japanese.Text: サムとリングリンは

English.Text: I'll never forget those two.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボ愛と情熱にあふれる
すばらしい青年たちじゃったの

English.Text: They had such a powerful passion─and an eagerness to learn too.

Japanese.Text: 毎日　熱心に勉強しておったわい

English.Text: Everything they did was for the birds.

Japanese.Text: そんなはずはありません！

English.Text: That's not the Sam I know!

Japanese.Text:
父さんと母さんは
サムにはめられて死んだんだ

English.Text: Sam's a demon. He led my parents to an early grave.

Japanese.Text:
ギャンブル漬けにされて
借金を背負わされて　それで――

English.Text: Got them hooked on gambling, pushed 'em to rack up tons of debt...and then...

Japanese.Text: ふ～む　信じられんのう

English.Text: Hmm, that don't sound like him to me.

Japanese.Text:
サムはサムでも
サム違いということはないのかの？

English.Text:
You sure you ain't got your Sams mixed up?
It's a common name, y'know.

Japanese.Text: チョコボ業界にサムはひとりです！

English.Text: Only one "Sam" in this business!

Japanese.Text:
だからぼくは　ゴールドカップに出て
サムのチョコボをコテンパンに打ち負かして

English.Text: I swore that I'd humiliate him by winning the Gold Cup─destroy his reputation.

Japanese.Text:
父さんと母さんの
カタキを取らなきゃダメなんだ　絶対に！

English.Text: Then I'd at least have some kind of revenge for what that bastard did to my parents!

Japanese.Text: まあ……それはそれとして　じゃな

English.Text: Now that that's outta your system...back to it.

Japanese.Text: 仙人！

English.Text: Excuse me!?

Japanese.Text:
おまえさんは　チョコボのことを
学びに来たのではなかったのかのう

English.Text: You heard me. Thought you came out here to learn about chocobos, not to "get revenge."

Japanese.Text: クラウド

English.Text: Cloud...

Japanese.Text:
シレナに乗って　海や湖の上にふわふわ浮かんどる
『チョコボ草』をとってきてくれんかの？

English.Text: For your next task, I'll need you to take Selena and gather chocograss─which so happens to grow above bodies of water.

Japanese.Text:
あっ　このジジイ
またコキ使おうとしてる！

English.Text: You kiddin' me!? This fossil's trying to get us to do his dirty work again!?

Japanese.Text:
チョコボ草は万能薬
あれを飲めば　ワシの朽ちかけた体も元気になろう

English.Text: Chocograss is a genuine panacea. I kid you not─it'll cure whatever ails ya, and then some.

Japanese.Text:
気分も良くなって
昔話も気持ちよくできるというもの

English.Text: And once I am cured...maybe I'll be inclined to share more stories about the good old days.

Japanese.Text: あ～　完全にだましにきてる

English.Text: Ugh. He's obviously full of it.

Japanese.Text:
たとえそうでも
クラウド　お願い！

English.Text: If not for him, then please─do it for me!

Japanese.Text: どうしても　父さんのことが知りたいんだ

English.Text: I need to know what happened to my dad!

Japanese.Text: わかった

English.Text: Okay.

Japanese.Text: チョコボ草　またの名を浮遊草

English.Text: When I said it grows above water, I meant above.

Japanese.Text:
その名のとおり
空中に浮かんでいる不思議な草じゃが

English.Text: It's called the "floatin' flower" 'cause it grows in the air...

Japanese.Text: 海チョコボの力を使えば　スイスイのスイよ

English.Text: but with an ocean chocobo, you can harvest the stuff with ease.

Japanese.Text: ３０は欲しいの

English.Text: Thirty tufts oughta do.

Japanese.Text:
急げよ　クラウド
ワシの残り時間は少ないぞ

English.Text: Best hop to it, Cloud. You don't want my death on your hands, do ya?

Japanese.Text: 父さんとサムが　ここで修行してたなんて

English.Text: Can't believe my dad and uncle trained here back in the day.

Japanese.Text:
もしかして　サムは弟子の時から
父さんをだましていたのかも

English.Text: I bet he was schemin' against my dad ever since they were both apprentices...

Japanese.Text: チョコボ草は集まった？

English.Text: Y'find any chocograss?

Japanese.Text:
海チョコボの力を使えば
浮かんでるチョコボ草をとれるはずだよ

English.Text: Y'all should have no trouble snaggin' some if you've got a bird that can walk on water.

Japanese.Text:
ねえ　サムって誰？
クラウドも知ってるっぽかったけど

English.Text: Hey, since you seem to be in the know, gimme the skinny. Who's this Sam guy?

Japanese.Text: ウォール・マーケットの住人だ

English.Text: Big shot in Wall Market.

Japanese.Text: ああ　じゃあ悪党だね

English.Text: Aha. So he must be pretty scummy.

Japanese.Text:
いや　どうかな
そこまでの悪いやつという印象はない

English.Text: I dunno... Corneo business aside, he didn't strike me as a total asshole.

Japanese.Text: へえ～

English.Text: Interesting...

Japanese.Text:
でもさ　それって
クラウドがだまされたんじゃない？

English.Text: Or maybe your powers of perception weren't honed enough to see through his facade.

Japanese.Text: 適当なことを言うな

English.Text: That's gotta be it...

Japanese.Text:
だって　クラウドだもん
本気でやられたら　ころっとだまされそうだよね

English.Text: Oh, if only I had found you sooner. I could have saved you from your own gullibility!

Japanese.Text:
チョコボ草　じゅうぶん集まったね
どうする　じいさんに届ける？

English.Text: That's a decent amount of chocograss, I suppose. Well, whaddya think? Should we take it back to the sage?

Japanese.Text:
チョコボ草　ぜ～んぶゲット～！
あとは届けるだけだね

English.Text: Holy crap, that's─that's all of it! Old sageykins is gonna owe us big time!

Japanese.Text:
おかえり
チョコボ草　手に入った？

English.Text: Oh, welcome back. Get any chocograss?

Japanese.Text: 仙人が待ちわびてるよ

English.Text: Sage's gonna be real pleased.

Japanese.Text: おお　チョコボ草は手に入ったかの？

English.Text: Oh! You get your hands on that chocograss?

Japanese.Text:
うん？
おまえさん　なんも持っとらんぞ

English.Text: Huh? Is this a joke? Ya ain't got nothin'.

Japanese.Text: うん　こんだけか？　もっと必要じゃの

English.Text: Huh? This all ya got? It ain't nowhere near enough.

Japanese.Text: チョコボ草　またの名を浮遊草

English.Text: Some folks also call it the "floatin' flower."

Japanese.Text:
水がある場所の上空に
ふわふわ浮いとる　不思議な草じゃ

English.Text: They don't mean it metaphorically─it really floats above water.

Japanese.Text:
採取するには　シレナの力を
うま～く使いこなす必要があるの

English.Text: Makes it hard to get to. With Selena though, you'll glide over that water with the greatest of ease.

Japanese.Text:
ゲホゲホ……
急ぐのだ　クラウドよ

English.Text: ...Hurry. I don't have long to live.

Japanese.Text: おお　チョコボ草じゃチョコボ草じゃ

English.Text: Well, well. If it ain't my beloved chocograss!

Japanese.Text:
うれしいの～　ありがたいの～
おまえさんに頼んでよかったわい！

English.Text: This stuff can be one hell of a hassle to gather. Thank goodness I had you to get it for me!

Japanese.Text: んで　これをどうすんの？

English.Text: Okay, so what're you gonna do with it?

Japanese.Text: ふっふっふ　特別に教えてやろうかの～

English.Text: I suppose you've earned the right to know.

Japanese.Text:
この草をの　チョコボの羽根といっしょに
発酵乾燥させての　コトコトじっくり煮出すんじゃ

English.Text: First, I take this fluff, mix it with some chocobo feathers, and let it ferment. Once it's dry, I boil it all down.

Japanese.Text:
そいつを　ぎゅ～っとしぼりとったのが
このチョコボエキスじゃ！

English.Text: Then I squeeze it all out and─voila! My patented chocotincture!

Japanese.Text: それが万能薬なの？

English.Text: That some kinda magic medicine?

Japanese.Text: いんや　ただの嗜好品じゃ

English.Text: Oh, no. Just a little fun.

Japanese.Text: このジジイ～！

English.Text: This wrinkly, cheeky old...

Japanese.Text: シュシュシュ！

English.Text: Hih, chih, chih, chih!

Japanese.Text:
そうじゃ　チョコボ草がまだあるなら
あとは　店番をやっとる助手に渡してくれ

English.Text: Speakin' of grass, if you've got some extra tufts on hand, would you mind sharin' 'em with my assistant at the shop?

Japanese.Text: それなりの礼はするんでな

English.Text: I promise I'll make it worth your while.

Japanese.Text: 仙人　どうか父さんの話を！

English.Text: Please, tell me about my father.

Japanese.Text:
まだじゃ　あとひとつ
やらねばならないことがある

English.Text: Hold your chocobos, son. There's still one thing you need to do for me first.

Japanese.Text:
やっぱり！
ジジイ　なんにも教える気ないんじゃん

English.Text: What a surprise... This geezer isn't gonna tell you jack. Face it, kid!

Japanese.Text: ひどいこと言うの～

English.Text: You got a lotta nerve!

Japanese.Text:
しっかり学んでおいて
なんじゃ　その言い草は

English.Text: Castin' aspersions─after all the wisdom I've shared!

Japanese.Text: どういうことだ

English.Text: All the what now?

Japanese.Text: 騎手能力を鍛えてやったことに　気づかんか？

English.Text: So you haven't realized you've been trainin' this whole time?

Japanese.Text:
シレナの捕獲を通じて
チョコボの気持ちを読む力を

English.Text: Trackin' down Selena forced you to get in touch with a chocobo's feelings.

Japanese.Text:
シレナに乗って海を走ることで　バランス感覚と
操縦技術を向上させたというワケじゃ

English.Text: And all that runnin' across the water you did helped hone your sense of balance and your bird handlin'─key skills for any aspirin' jockey.

Japanese.Text:
どうじゃ　クラウド
ひと皮むけた気がするじゃろ？

English.Text: Whaddya say, Cloud? Betcha feel like a real choco-pro by now.

Japanese.Text: 実感がない

English.Text: Can't say I do.

Japanese.Text:
それは困った問題じゃの
やはり　もうひと課題やらねばな

English.Text: Sounds to me like you need more trainin'. Reckon we oughta add one more item to your regimen.

Japanese.Text: 言わば　最終試験じゃ

English.Text: Think of it as a "final trial" of sorts.

Japanese.Text:
また～？　っていうか
試験ってなに　話変わってない？

English.Text: Oh, give me a break. Don't go changin' the subject here, Gramps! We're not doing your stupid "trial"!

Japanese.Text: いやいい　やる

English.Text: No, it's fine. I'll do it.

Japanese.Text: よ～し　ワシと競争じゃ！

English.Text: Then it's settled! I'll be your opponent.

Japanese.Text: おまえさんには　シレナを貸してやろう

English.Text: And dear Selena'll be your steed.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドが勝ったら
父さんの話　聞かせてくれますね？

English.Text: If Cloud wins...does that mean you'll finally tell me about my dad?

Japanese.Text:
よかろう
せえぜえシレナの調整に励むがいい

English.Text: You've got a deal─but know that I won't be pullin' any punches out there.

Japanese.Text: クラウド　準備ができたら声をかけてくれい

English.Text: When you're ready, gimme a holler and we can hit the track.

Japanese.Text: 最終試験の準備はできたかの？

English.Text: You prepared to undertake the final trial?

Japanese.Text: 準備はしっかりね

English.Text: Make sure you're good an' ready.

Japanese.Text: どのパーツにする？

English.Text: What're ya thinkin'?

Japanese.Text: さすが　仙人のチョコボだね

English.Text: The sage's bird is somethin' else.

Japanese.Text: 調整すれば　望みはあるよ

English.Text: Let's try some different gear!

Japanese.Text: 絶対に勝ってね

English.Text: I'm countin' on ya, Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
ふ～む　まだ教えが
体に染みついておらんようじゃの

English.Text: Hmm... You know what I've taught you, but you haven't applied it.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　あと何度か競争すれば
なじんでくるわ

English.Text: Meh... "If at first you don't succeed," et cetera.

Japanese.Text: というわけで　試験は続行じゃ

English.Text: Now hop to─prove you've got what it takes.

Japanese.Text: しっかり反省し　次につなげるんじゃな

English.Text: Learn from your mistakes. Only then will ya be able to improve.

Japanese.Text: もっとチョコボと一体になるよう　心掛けよ

English.Text: Don't just ride the bird, ride with the bird!

Japanese.Text: レースパーツを見直してみるのも手じゃよ

English.Text: Remember, your gear's as important as your bird.

Japanese.Text: ふひひ　かなり苦労したようじゃな

English.Text: Hahaha. Took ya a couple tries, I see.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　うまく操縦できんからといって
落ち込まんでええぞ

English.Text: But hey, don't let a rough run or two make ya question if you're cut out for this life.

Japanese.Text:
それだけ　チョコボは
奥が深い生き物ということじゃ

English.Text: Bird handlin' is an art─one that requires hours of practice to perfect.

Japanese.Text: これからも　敬意を持って鍛錬するがよい

English.Text: So keep on keepin' on. You'll get there someday.

Japanese.Text: 鍛錬の成果が　うまく出たようじゃな

English.Text: Looks like all that trainin' I made ya do paid off.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボとの一体感が
グングンとあがっていくのが　よ～くわかったわい

English.Text: Thanks to my regimen, I'd say you're head and shoulders above your average amateur.

Japanese.Text: のう　お嬢さん？

English.Text: Wouldn't you agree?

Japanese.Text:
ぐぬぬ……　うさんくさいのに
結果が出たから文句が言えない～

English.Text: ...As much as I'd love to tell you you're wrong 'cause I think you're the worst, you do have a point.

Japanese.Text:
おほほ　これからは
雑用をあなどらんことじゃの～

English.Text: Even "the worst" can teach you a thing or two─if you let him.

Japanese.Text:
これはこれは　予想以上の結果じゃわい
おまえさん　元々やり手だったようじゃな

English.Text: Pluck my ever-lovin' feathers! That was one hell of a performance! If I didn't know better, I'd say this wasn't your first rodeo.

Japanese.Text: いまさらだな

English.Text: Surprise.

Japanese.Text: いやはや　この歳になって

English.Text: Well, shoot. Ya got me good.

Japanese.Text:
とんでもない怪物レーサーを
生み出してしまったやもしれんの

English.Text: And once ya start tearin' up the track out there, the racing world'll blame me for lettin' ya loose.

Japanese.Text:
仙人　約束どおり
父さんとサムについて教えてください！

English.Text: A promise is a promise, sir. Please tell me more about my dad and Uncle Sam.

Japanese.Text:
ふむ　よかろう
なにが知りたい？

English.Text: Hmm... Alright then. Whaddya want to know?

Japanese.Text:
ちょうど　おまえさんぐらいの歳じゃったかの
ふたりで『弟子にしろ』と　押しかけてきよった

English.Text: Let's see... They couldna been much older than you are now. The two of 'em came and asked me to take 'em under my wing.

Japanese.Text:
ワシは隠居しとったから相手にせなんだが
勝手に居座りよってな

English.Text: Turned 'em down─seein' as I had already retired─but they hung around the grounds anyway.

Japanese.Text:
しかたがないので
適当に雑用を押しつけたのが始まりじゃわ

English.Text: Since they had nothin' better to do, I put 'em to work─and that's how it all began.

Japanese.Text: べつに　普通の暮らしをしていただけじゃよ

English.Text: Oh, wasn't nothing outta the ordinary, I'd say.

Japanese.Text:
掃除やら買い出しやら屋敷の修繕やら
いろいろと修行してもらったの～

English.Text: Ran some errands, did some repairs, helped around the house... You know, your standard trainin' regimen.

Japanese.Text:
その合間に　勝手にチョコボの生態を調べたり
書物をあさったりしておったようじゃが

English.Text: And in their downtime, they took it upon themselves to dig through my library─learnin' about chocobos and how to handle 'em.

Japanese.Text: チョコボ育成について　よく言い争っておったわ

English.Text: Came to differing conclusions. They used to argue somethin' fierce.

Japanese.Text: 決して　仲は良くなかったの

English.Text: I can't say the two of 'em got on terribly well.

Japanese.Text: やっぱり

English.Text: I figured.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボ育成についての思想が根本的に違うんじゃ
よく討論が殴り合いのケンカになっておったわ

English.Text: Will and Sam had mighty strong opinions about how to best raise chocobos, and it drove 'em to fight─with their words, and with their fists.

Japanese.Text:
ただ　チョコボにかける情熱だけは
お互いに認め合っていたようじゃった

English.Text: That said, only reason those two fought as hard as they did is 'cause they both cared deeply about the cause.

Japanese.Text: 心の底では繋がっていたと　ワシは思っておる

English.Text: As far as passion is concerned, the two of 'em were birds of a feather.

Japanese.Text: さて　ほかに聞きたいことはあるかの？

English.Text: Now then. Ya got any other burnin' questions?

Japanese.Text: ふむ　すこしは心の整理ができたかいの

English.Text: Hmm... How ya feel now? Manage to sort out the mess inside?

Japanese.Text: どういうことですか？

English.Text: ...What do you mean?

Japanese.Text:
おまえさんの
怒りに満ちた瞳をはじめて見たとき

English.Text: When we first met, I saw the way your eyes were brimmin' with anger.

Japanese.Text:
こやつに必要なのは
知識や技術じゃないと思っての

English.Text: I knew right then and there that what you needed wasn't teachin' or trainin'.

Japanese.Text:
まずは邪念を取り払い　いまいちど
己を見つめ直す時間を与えようと考えたわけじゃ

English.Text: What you needed was time─time to look deep inside yourself and clear out all the wickedness and spite that have been hauntin' your heart.

Japanese.Text: だから　掃除をさせていたのか

English.Text: Which is why you had him clean out the pool?

Japanese.Text: いかにも

English.Text: Exactly.

Japanese.Text:
リングリンになにがあったのか
ワシにはわからん

English.Text: I don't know what happened to your father after he left this place.

Japanese.Text:
おまえさんがサムを憎む気持ちは　よ～くわかる
復讐のために　レースに勝ちたいというのもわかる

English.Text: And I can understand why you'd wanna beat old Sam in a race. Few things feel better than stickin' it to someone who did you wrong.

Japanese.Text:
しかし　その気持ちを
チョコボにぶつけてはいかん

English.Text: But that bein' said, you should never use your birds as tools for revenge.

Japanese.Text: おまえさんは　なんのためにチョコボを育てておる

English.Text: Ask yourself "Why did I decide to start raisin' chocobos?"

Japanese.Text: ぼくは……

English.Text: I guess...

Japanese.Text:
父さんや母さんが　チョコボのことを
嬉しそうに話しているのが好きで

English.Text: I guess it's 'cause I saw how happy those birds made my mom and dad─how they'd smile...

Japanese.Text:
家族みんなで　チョコボに乗って出かけるのが
楽しくて　だからぼくは……

English.Text: The chocobos brought us a lotta fun, and brought us together as a family... I guess that's why.

Japanese.Text: それでよい

English.Text: Good enough.

Japanese.Text: その記憶を　決して忘れぬようにな

English.Text: The "why" is important─so don't forget yours.

Japanese.Text:
ゴールドカップには　サムも出るじゃろう
憎しみにとらわれてはならんぞ

English.Text: I reckon Sam's got his eyes on the Gold Cup. Keep yours unclouded by hatred, and you'll do fine.

Japanese.Text: はい　仙人

English.Text: Thank you, sir.

Japanese.Text: いろいろ　ありがとう

English.Text: Thanks for everything.

Japanese.Text:
これから　ゴールドソーサーに戻って
チョコボの最終調整をするよ

English.Text: I'm gonna head back to the Saucer─make sure our birds're ready for the big race.

Japanese.Text:
騎手はクラウドでエントリーしておくからさ
ゴールドカップが始まったら　よろしくね

English.Text: Don't worry about puttin' your name in. I'll take care of it. All you need to do is show up and win.

Japanese.Text:
父さんや母さんのことだけじゃなくて
サムのこと　もっと知らないと

English.Text: There's still lots I'd like to know about my parents. Lots more I'd like to know about my uncle Sam too.

Japanese.Text: サムと話すためにも　レースに勝たなくちゃ

English.Text: Maybe winnin' that race'll give me a chance to ask him myself.

Japanese.Text:
このワシに勝ったんじゃから
そこらへんのチョコボに負けるでないぞ

English.Text: No losin' to anyone else, y'hear? Can't have ya draggin' my good name through the mud.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボ草も手に入ったし
エキスの仕込みを始めようかの

English.Text: Now that I have that chocograss... Should start makin' some of that tincture.

Japanese.Text:
どうじゃ　おまえさんも
チョコボエキスを吸ってみんか？

English.Text: Hey there. Whaddya say? Wanna smoke some of this tincture?

Japanese.Text:
どうじゃ　シレナの乗り心地は
優雅なもんじゃろ

English.Text: So, how's it feel ridin' Selena? Elegance incarnate, ain't she?

Japanese.Text:
おお　聞いたぞ
ゴールドカップで勝ったらしいの

English.Text: Hey, I heard the news! Congratulations on winnin' the Cup!

Japanese.Text:
絶対王者のサムと
伝説のジョーを破った新星現る　とな

English.Text: I knew you were good, but to dismantle Sam and Joe's dynasty...that's quite a feat.

Japanese.Text:
ほほほ　チョコボ業界が
にぎやかになってきたの～

English.Text: Your victory's got the whole industry in an uproar.

Japanese.Text:
新たな風が吹くのは
チョコボにとってもいいことじゃからな

English.Text: And I, for one, am glad. A breath of fresh air'll at least do the chocobos good.

Japanese.Text: キミも　仙人に弟子入りしにきたの？

English.Text: Are you here to learn from the sage as well?

Japanese.Text:
仙人の相手は　ものすご～く大変だと思うけど
根気よくがんばってね

English.Text: I know the sage is a bit of a handful, but stick with it, okay? It'll all pay off in the end─I promise.

Japanese.Text: ここの店番もチョコボ修行なんだ

English.Text: Running this shop is an extension of my training.

Japanese.Text:
いらっしゃい
チョコボの調子　どう？

English.Text: Hi there. Everything going okay?

Japanese.Text: お互い　がんばろう

English.Text: Good luck out there.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　またね

English.Text: I'll see you around.

Japanese.Text: チョコボ草があったら　引き取るよ

English.Text: You got any chocograss for me?

Japanese.Text:
ありがとう
また集まったら　持ってきてよ

English.Text: Thanks! If you find any more, I'll be here.

Japanese.Text:
ありがとう
これだけあればじゅうぶん！

English.Text: Thanks so much! I think that about does it.

Japanese.Text:
このあたりのチョコボ草は
とりつくしちゃったみたいだね

English.Text: Pretty sure you've picked all there is to find around here.

Japanese.Text: キミはもう　海チョコボマスターだよ

English.Text: You're a true ocean chocobo tamer.

Japanese.Text: 羽根も交換していくかい？

English.Text: Now, how about plumes?

Japanese.Text:
集めてくれたチョコボ草は
大切に使わせてもらうよ

English.Text: Don't worry, I'll put the chocograss you gave me to good use.

Japanese.Text:
ニャン　ニャンニャンニャ～ニャ～ン
白い毛の　天使ちゃん♪

English.Text:
Meow, meow meow meow, meow!
My dearest white-haired angel♪

Japanese.Text:
ニャン　ニャンニャンニャ～ニャ～ン
どこに行っちゃったのか～し～ら～♪

English.Text:
Meow, meow meow meow, meow!
Where have you wandered off to now, my love?♪

Japanese.Text:
ごはん用意して～
待っているのにネコちゃんは～♪

English.Text:
All your favorite foods are waiting...
So please come home to me, darling!♪

Japanese.Text:
やってこない～
しんしんしん心配ね～♪

English.Text:
You've been gone for days...
So worried I can't help but sing!♪

Japanese.Text:
クラウドのうち
７歳か　８歳以来かな

English.Text: First time in your house since I was what─seven? Eight?

Japanese.Text: いまは調理場らしい

English.Text: Isn't really mine though...

Japanese.Text: おやお～や　な～にか用かい？

English.Text: Hello, dear. May I help you?♪

Japanese.Text: いえ　すてきな歌だと思って

English.Text: Just listening. You've got a great voice.

Japanese.Text: あら　恥ずかしい

English.Text: Oh, you flatter me!

Japanese.Text:
実はね　時々ごはんをあげてるネコちゃんが
行方不明で　心配で心配で

English.Text: I didn't even know I was doing it. You see, this cat I feed sometimes has gone missing─and when I worry...

Japanese.Text: ちょっと

English.Text: Hey.

Japanese.Text: 歌っちゃう～の～♪

English.Text: I cannot heeelp but siiing♪

Japanese.Text: クラウド　なんでも屋の出番

English.Text: Sounds like a job for a merc, doesn't it?

Japanese.Text:
あら　感情が高まったら
つい歌ってしまわな～～～い♪

English.Text:
Why, I sing whenever the mood strikes, really.
Haven't you ever felt like bursting into song?♪

Japanese.Text: いいえ　私は

English.Text: No, I...can't say I have.

Japanese.Text: 音楽はしないの？

English.Text: You've got an ear for music, though.

Japanese.Text:
子供の頃に　ピアノをやってました
ママに教えてもらって

English.Text:
I played piano a little when I was younger.
My mom taught me.

Japanese.Text:
あら　いいわね
いつか伴奏してちょうだい

English.Text:
My, that's lovely!
You ought to accompany me sometime.

Japanese.Text: はい　機会があれば　ぜひ

English.Text: Sure. I bet it'd be a lotta fun.

Japanese.Text: ねえ

English.Text: C'mon.

Japanese.Text: そのネコ　俺たちが探そう

English.Text: If you like...we can go look for your cat.

Japanese.Text: ホントかい　助かるよ

English.Text: Really!? Oh, what a relief!

Japanese.Text:
あら　自信満々ね
あなた　もしかしてプロのネコ探し屋さん？

English.Text: Well, aren't you the picture of confidence! You wouldn't happen to be a professional feline finder, would you?

Japanese.Text: なんでも屋だ　ネコ探しの実績もある

English.Text: Not officially, but I've got a good cat-catching record.

Japanese.Text: 子供の頃から　やってるからな

English.Text: Been doing it since I was a kid.

Japanese.Text: そうだねえ

English.Text: I certainly hope so...

Japanese.Text: ただ　モンスターが増えてるって言うでしょ？

English.Text: But I can't help but worry with all those fiends lurking about.

Japanese.Text:
ネコちゃんが～
襲われて～　いないか～♪

English.Text:
Oh, dearest kitty, my darling kitty
Where could you be?♪

Japanese.Text: 考えれ～ば　考える～ほど～♪

English.Text:
I'm filled with worry
Oh, won't you please hurry to me?♪

Japanese.Text: クラウド　探してあげない？

English.Text: I mean it Cloud─she needs help.

Japanese.Text: わかった

English.Text: Alright.

Japanese.Text: ホントかい　助かるよ

English.Text: Really!? Oh, what a relief!

Japanese.Text:
ふふん　私はダーエ
ここの料理長よ

English.Text: I'm Christine by the way. Chef and chanteuse.

Japanese.Text:
ネコちゃんは
ニブル山のふもとに住んでるみたい

English.Text: You might want to start by looking around the foot of Mt. Nibel.

Japanese.Text: 野良なのに真っ白で　すらりとしたキレイな子よ

English.Text:
She's got the most beautiful snow-white coat.
Petite little thing too.

Japanese.Text:
そうだ　お腹を空かせてるだろうから
これを持っていって

English.Text:
Speaking of, she must be starving out there!
Here─be sure to feed her.

Japanese.Text:
ネコちゃんはまかせて～
私は　料理に集中よ♪

English.Text:
I'll leave you to find my darling cat
While I cook up a mighty feast!♪

Japanese.Text:
トントトントン　ト～ントント～ン～
トントトントン　ト～ントント～ン～♪

English.Text:
Dum dum dum dadada dada dada
Dum dum dum, da da da dum♪

Japanese.Text: ネコちゃんのこと　お願いね～♪

English.Text: Be a dear and find my darling cat!♪

Japanese.Text: うちのマルのこと　思い出しちゃった

English.Text: All this talk of cats makes me think of Fluffy.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　俺もだ
結局あいつはどうなったんだ？

English.Text:
Yeah─the one and only.
...What happened to her anyway?

Japanese.Text: ５年前　村が燃えている時に別れたきり

English.Text: No idea. Haven't seen her since the fire five years ago.

Japanese.Text: そうか……

English.Text: Damn...

Japanese.Text: 私が捨てたみたいな　そんな感じかな

English.Text: I can't shake the feeling that I just...left her to die.

Japanese.Text:
生きていてほしいって思う
資格もないような気がするんだ

English.Text: I really hope she's okay, but...if she's not...

Japanese.Text:
なあ　ティファ
気になっていたことがあるんだ

English.Text: Hey, there's...something I've been meaning to ask you.

Japanese.Text: なに？

English.Text: What?

Japanese.Text:
あのティファのネコ　どうしてマルって言うんだ
べつに丸くなかったよな

English.Text: How come you named your cat "Fluffy"? It's not like her fur was long or super soft or anything.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　あれ
マルはね　１２歳の誕生日に村長がくれたんだよね

English.Text: Well, to be fair, I wasn't the one who named her. The mayor gave her to me as a gift for my twelfth birthday.

Japanese.Text:
その時に村長が『この子はマルだ』って言ったの
だから　理由はわからない

English.Text: When he put her in my arms he said, "this little lady's name is Fluffy," but he never explained why.

Japanese.Text: もちろん　新しい名前をつけるつもりでいたけど

English.Text: Don't get me wrong─I was dead set on giving her a better name.

Japanese.Text:
それより先に　マルっていう名前が
村中に広まっちゃった

English.Text: But before I could, everyone had already started calling her "Fluffy."

Japanese.Text:
いい名前って思うようになるまで
そんなにかからなかったけど

English.Text: And the more I heard it, the more I thought "Well, maybe it's not that bad..."

Japanese.Text: あの頃は　私も面倒な年頃だったからなあ

English.Text: So I let it stick. I wasn't much of a fighter back in those days.

Japanese.Text: ふん……

English.Text: Heh...

Japanese.Text: クラウドほどじゃないけどね

English.Text: Hard to believe lookin' at me now.

Japanese.Text: どうしたの？

English.Text: What's up?

Japanese.Text: 声がする

English.Text: Heard something.

Japanese.Text: あそこだ

English.Text: Over there.

Japanese.Text: 追いかけよう

English.Text: Let's go.

Japanese.Text:
マル　いつも首に赤い布を巻いていたの
覚えてるかな

English.Text: Hey, do you remember that red bandana Fluffy always had around her neck?

Japanese.Text: ああ　そうだったな

English.Text: Now that you mention it...

Japanese.Text:
あれね　パパが巻いたの
自分の古いシャツを切って

English.Text: Believe it or not, my dad made it. With cloth from one of his old shirts.

Japanese.Text:
私がもらってきたネコなのに
パパのほうがかわいがってたかも

English.Text: Even though she was my cat, I think he took better care of her.

Japanese.Text: そうか

English.Text: That right?

Japanese.Text: ごめん　こんな話

English.Text: Sorry. Didn't mean to bring him up.

Japanese.Text: いや　いいんだ

English.Text: No need to apologize.

Japanese.Text: ねえ　声の主　増えてない？

English.Text: Hey, it's starting to sound like a cat chorus.

Japanese.Text: あそこ！

English.Text: Look.

Japanese.Text: 子猫？

English.Text: Kittens?

Japanese.Text: シャーッ！

English.Text: Hsss!

Japanese.Text: もしかして　マル？

English.Text: I can't believe it... Fluffy?

Japanese.Text: マル　覚えてない？

English.Text: Hey, girl. How you doin'?

Japanese.Text: ほら　私　ティファだよ

English.Text: It's me─Tifa! Remember?

Japanese.Text: よかった　無事だったんだ

English.Text: You're okay. Thank god.

Japanese.Text: にゃー

English.Text: Meow!

Japanese.Text: マル！

English.Text: Aw!

Japanese.Text: マル　大丈夫？

English.Text: Fluffy!? What's wrong?

Japanese.Text: 衰弱してる

English.Text: She doesn't look so good.

Japanese.Text: そうだ　キャットフード

English.Text: Let's try giving her the cat food!

Japanese.Text: たくさんあるから　ゆっくり食べて

English.Text: There's plenty more where this came from, so dig in.

Japanese.Text: 守らなくちゃ！

English.Text: Leave 'em alone!

Japanese.Text: ニャ～

English.Text: Mrow.

Japanese.Text: ニャ～！

English.Text: Mrow.

Japanese.Text: 追いかけよう

English.Text: C'mon.

Japanese.Text: シャーッ！

English.Text: Hsss!

Japanese.Text: ニャ～

English.Text: Mrowr.

Japanese.Text: 追いかけよう

English.Text: Let's move.

Japanese.Text: シャーッ！

English.Text: Hsss!

Japanese.Text: シャーッ！

English.Text: Hsss!

Japanese.Text: ニャー……

English.Text: Meow...

Japanese.Text:
マルたちのケガの具合も確認したいし
いったん　村に戻ろっか

English.Text: I'm a little worried Fluffy and the kittens might've been hurt. Do you mind if we head back to the village?

Japanese.Text:
連れて帰ったら　ダーエさん
世話してくれそうな感じだったよね

English.Text: You know, if we asked her nicely, I bet that head chef would take care of the kittens.

Japanese.Text: クラウドも　いっしょに頼んでくれる？

English.Text: I mean, can't say no to both of us, right?

Japanese.Text: ああ　帰ろう

English.Text: Guess we'll see. C'mon.

Japanese.Text: ウウ～……

English.Text: Mew...

Japanese.Text:
そっか　私たちが住んでいた村とは
違うもんね

English.Text: Huh... Guess even she can tell this place is nothing like it used to be.

Japanese.Text: だから　村に戻らなかったんだろうな

English.Text: That's probably why she never came back here.

Japanese.Text: どうしたの？

English.Text: What is it?

Japanese.Text: マル？

English.Text: Fluffy?

Japanese.Text: 追いかけよう

English.Text: After 'em.

Japanese.Text: おや　あんたたち

English.Text: Why, look who it is!

Japanese.Text:
あら　ネコちゃん！
無事だったのね

English.Text: Oh, my little baby! I'm so glad you're okay!

Japanese.Text: しかも　こんなカワイコちゃんたちまで

English.Text: And just look at all these yummy muffins you brought back with you!

Japanese.Text: ニブル山で産んだみたいです

English.Text: She gave birth to her litter on the mountain.

Japanese.Text: おやおや　ご苦労だったねえ

English.Text: Oh, sweetling! You're going to be a great mommy.

Japanese.Text: それで　その……

English.Text: I hope this is alright.

Japanese.Text:
山での子育ては　難しいと思って
連れてきてしまったんですけど

English.Text:
It wasn't exactly safe for a bunch of kittens.
Couldn't just leave them, so...

Japanese.Text:
あ～はいはい　心配しないで
これからは　私が責任を持って面倒を見るから

English.Text: Don't be silly, dear! You did the right thing. I'll take excellent care of this family. They'll want for nothing.

Japanese.Text:
ネコちゃんに囲まれ～
料理するのが　夢だったの～♪

English.Text:
Long I've dreamed of opening my home
To little ones to play and roam and love!♪

Japanese.Text: ララララ～♪

English.Text: La la, la la, lalalalalalalala!♪

Japanese.Text: うちの子になるなら　名前が必要だね

English.Text:
If I'm to take these cats in,
they're going to need names.

Japanese.Text:
あんたは真っ白でキレイだから　シロだ
間違いのない　いい名前だろ

English.Text:
You've got such beautiful white fur─"Blanca"!
Yes, that fits perfectly, don't you think?

Japanese.Text: 子供たちは　あとで考えよう

English.Text: As for the kittens─we'll decide later.

Japanese.Text: いや　そのネコの名前は──

English.Text: Actually, the cat's already got a na...

Japanese.Text:
おや　ピアノが聴きたいのかい？
でもごめんね　私はさっきのが精一杯なんだよ

English.Text: What─you weren't hoping to hear me play, were you? I'm terribly sorry, Blanca, but I'm a bit worn out after all that excitement.

Japanese.Text: ティファが弾けばいい

English.Text: Tifa can play.

Japanese.Text: えっ？

English.Text: Cloud!

Japanese.Text: ニャ～

English.Text: Meow.

Japanese.Text: いいわね　私もぜひ聴きたいわ

English.Text:
What a wonderful idea!
You'll humor us dear, won't you?

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　ちょっとだけ

English.Text: Okay─just a bit.

Japanese.Text: そうだ　せっかくだから伴奏もつけようか

English.Text:
Hold that thought!
This occasion calls for an accompaniment!

Japanese.Text:
演奏をたしなむ連中を呼んでくるから
ちょっと待ってて！

English.Text: I know some folks who would just love the chance to perform. Don't go anywhere!

Japanese.Text:
どうしよう　クラウド
なんだか　大変なことになってる

English.Text:
That escalated quickly...
I wasn't expecting an audience.

Japanese.Text: ピアノの練習してたのって　子供の頃だけだよ

English.Text:
I haven't practiced since I was a kid.
What should I do?

Japanese.Text: 逃げるか？

English.Text: Back out?

Japanese.Text: それは　できない

English.Text: Well, that's not an option.

Japanese.Text: じゃあ　練習だな

English.Text: Then I think you better get warmed up.

Japanese.Text: 心地よい音色だわ

English.Text: What a melodious sound!

Japanese.Text: うっとりしちゃう

English.Text: A captivating performance.

Japanese.Text: 歌いたくなってきちゃった

English.Text: I'm tempted to burst into song!

Japanese.Text: 音が染みこんでくるわ

English.Text: Your playing spoke to my soul.

Japanese.Text: なんて指さばきなの

English.Text: Such remarkable skill!

Japanese.Text: あらら～

English.Text: Oh, dear...

Japanese.Text: すこしズレてるわね

English.Text: That was a bit pitchy...

Japanese.Text: まわりの音を聴いて

English.Text: Keep it in key.

Japanese.Text: 持ち直せるわよ

English.Text: I know you can do better.

Japanese.Text: 落ち着いて

English.Text: Easy, now...

Japanese.Text: あらあらあらあら……

English.Text: Well, that was...

Japanese.Text: ごめんなさい　調子に乗っちゃった

English.Text: Sorry about that. Definitely rusty.

Japanese.Text: ……よかった

English.Text: No! You were...great.

Japanese.Text: ありがと

English.Text: Thanks.

Japanese.Text: よかったわよ

English.Text: That was lovely.

Japanese.Text: ニャ～

English.Text: Meow...!

Japanese.Text: どうだった？

English.Text: How was it?

Japanese.Text: 子供の頃より　ずっといい

English.Text: Much better than I remember, that's for sure.

Japanese.Text: ぜんぜん　ほめられてる気がしないけど

English.Text: Talk about a backhanded compliment.

Japanese.Text: うれしい　ありがとう

English.Text: But I'll take it. Thanks.

Japanese.Text: アンビリーバボー！

English.Text: Marvelous! Simply marvelous!

Japanese.Text: ニャ～！

English.Text: Mrowr!

Japanese.Text: どうだった？

English.Text: How was it?

Japanese.Text:
正直驚いた
本当に　ずっと弾いていないのか

English.Text: Honestly? I'm impressed. You sure you haven't played since you were a kid?

Japanese.Text: クラウドがいるから　はりきっちゃった

English.Text: Wow, a genuine compliment.

Japanese.Text: この子たちのこと　よろしくお願いします

English.Text:
Glad that you could help.
Take care of the cats for me.

Japanese.Text: まかせなさ～い！

English.Text: I certainly will!

Japanese.Text:
うふふ　美味しいものを
たらふく食べさせてあげるからね

English.Text: Rest assured I'll keep them very well fed!

Japanese.Text: 覚悟しときなさいよ

English.Text: So bring your appetites!

Japanese.Text: ニャ～

English.Text: Mrow!

Japanese.Text: さあ　ついてきな

English.Text: Alright! Come along then!

Japanese.Text:
ピアノを弾きながら
いろいろ　思い出しちゃった

English.Text: Playing that piano again brought back a lot of memories.

Japanese.Text:
ママにピアノを教えてもらったこと
パパの雑な　でも美味しい料理

English.Text: How Mom used to teach me while Dad was downstairs in the kitchen, doing his best─which was pretty good.

Japanese.Text: エミリオたちとのお茶会

English.Text: Hang-outs with Emilio and the gang.

Japanese.Text: クラウドは　何度誘ってもこなかったよね

English.Text: Which we kept inviting you to, but you never came.

Japanese.Text: そうだったか？

English.Text: "Never"? Really?

Japanese.Text: クラウド　ひとりぼっちでも平気だったよね

English.Text: Really. But you seemed fine on your own.

Japanese.Text: 俺のこと　そんな風に思ってたのか？

English.Text: That what it looked like? That I enjoyed being alone?

Japanese.Text: 違うの？

English.Text: You didn't?

Japanese.Text: 平気なわけない

English.Text: Of course not.

Japanese.Text: もっと知りたいな　クラウドのこと

English.Text: Huh... Guess we still don't know each other that well.

Japanese.Text: ああ　ときどき話そう

English.Text: Well, never too late to make up for lost time.

Japanese.Text: うん　きっとだよ

English.Text: Yeah. That's true.

Japanese.Text: 来てよかったね

English.Text: I'm glad we came.

Japanese.Text: ああ　マルも戻ったしな

English.Text: Yeah. Glad we found Fluffy too.

Japanese.Text:
今日からシロだよ
新しい家族といっしょに　幸せになってほしいな

English.Text: I think you mean "Blanca." But yeah... I hope she and the kittens are happy here.

Japanese.Text: 今度はピアノと歌で　セッションしましょうね

English.Text: It would be lovely if you could accompany me on the piano sometime!

Japanese.Text: さ～て　ネコちゃんの歌を作らないと

English.Text: I think I might have to try writing a song for my little kittens.

Japanese.Text: なにが起きやがった？

English.Text: What the hell just happened?

Japanese.Text: 様子　変わった？

English.Text: Did it just...change?

Japanese.Text: さっきまでと　ちゃいまっせ！

English.Text: Something's different about it!

Japanese.Text: またかよ！

English.Text: Not again!

Japanese.Text: もうっ！

English.Text: Come on!

Japanese.Text: これは　難儀やわ……

English.Text: This doesnae look good...

Japanese.Text: くそ　効いてねえか

English.Text: Didn't make a dent!

Japanese.Text: なあっ　通らねえ！

English.Text: This is gettin' us nowhere!

Japanese.Text: これじゃあ　ダメ？

English.Text: I don't think that did much.

Japanese.Text: あれっ？

English.Text: Huh!?

Japanese.Text: う～ん　イマイチですなあ

English.Text: ...Well that didnae work.

Japanese.Text: あっちゃ～……

English.Text: Whoops...

Japanese.Text: このまま続けんぞ！

English.Text: Can't keep up, can ya?

Japanese.Text: よろけてる？

English.Text: Too much?

Japanese.Text: 息　あがってるんとちゃう？

English.Text: A bit run down, eh?

Japanese.Text: 終わらせてやらあ！

English.Text: Let's finish it off!

Japanese.Text: やってやらあ！

English.Text: You're goin' down!

Japanese.Text: ごめん　行くよ！

English.Text: Wish it hadn't come to this...

Japanese.Text: 苦しませない！

English.Text: We'll make it quick!

Japanese.Text: これはもろたで！

English.Text: We've got him on the ropes!

Japanese.Text: ツッコミどころや！

English.Text: Now! Get in there!

Japanese.Text: 苦しんでる……？

English.Text: It's in pain...

Japanese.Text: こんなん　めちゃくちゃですわ！

English.Text: Ach, this isnae right!

Japanese.Text: 宝条の野郎　許さねえ！

English.Text: I swear, when I get my hands on Hojo...

Japanese.Text: 油断したか……

English.Text: Gettin' careless.

Japanese.Text: ありゃ～！

English.Text: Ach!

Japanese.Text: チッ　面倒くせえ！

English.Text: Ugh, this guy's a real pain in the ass!

Japanese.Text: 攻撃を止めなきゃ！

English.Text: Are you serious!?

Japanese.Text: もう　手加減なし？

English.Text: Ugh... How do we stop him?

Japanese.Text: やったな！

English.Text: Stop gettin' hit!

Japanese.Text: こんニャロ～！

English.Text: Just you try that again!

Japanese.Text: 確実に防ぐぞ

English.Text: Don't just take it!

Japanese.Text: きっちり守ってきましょ！

English.Text: Keep that guard up, eh!?

Japanese.Text: どーにか　隙を見つけんと！

English.Text: We have to look for an opening!

Japanese.Text: 動きが止まるときを狙う！

English.Text: Wait till he stops moving!

Japanese.Text: しまった！

English.Text: Dammit!

Japanese.Text: やりすぎや～！

English.Text: I'll feel that tomorrow!

Japanese.Text: なんつー威力だ！

English.Text: Bastard sure packs a punch!

Japanese.Text: どうしよう……

English.Text: Whadda we do?

Japanese.Text: もう　どうして……！

English.Text: There has to be a way...

Japanese.Text: どうにかしないと……

English.Text: Gotta get outta the way...

Japanese.Text: 何度もくらってらんないよ！

English.Text: Can't keep takin' these kind of hits!

Japanese.Text: 回避に集中しろ！

English.Text: Stay out of his way!

Japanese.Text: 逃げるが勝ちですわ！

English.Text: There's no shame in runnin'!

Japanese.Text: 来るぞ！

English.Text: Heads up!

Japanese.Text: なっ　なんか来まっせ！

English.Text: Look out!

Japanese.Text: 慌てない　慌てない

English.Text: There's no need to rush...

Japanese.Text: 無理せずゆっくり行きましょう

English.Text: Slow and steady wins the race.

Japanese.Text:
今日は調子よさそうですね
いいですよ

English.Text: Wow, you're doing great today. Keep it up.

Japanese.Text: ゆ～っくり　ゆ～っくり……

English.Text: Easy does it... Go at your own pace.

Japanese.Text: ごはんの時間まで　お散歩しましょう

English.Text: Why don't we take a short stroll before lunch?

Japanese.Text:
１歩ずつ　１歩ずつ
歩みを止めないで

English.Text: One step at a time. Keep going. You can do it.

Japanese.Text: ひと休みしましょう

English.Text: How about a break?

Japanese.Text: 大丈夫　時間はたっぷりあります

English.Text: It's okay. Take all the time you need, alright?

Japanese.Text: 無理は禁物　ゆっくり休みましょう

English.Text: No need to wear yourself out. Let's rest.

Japanese.Text:
今日の体調はどうです？
お変わりないですか

English.Text: So, how are you feeling today? Any changes?

Japanese.Text: 大丈夫　深呼吸して

English.Text: You're okay. Deep breaths...

Japanese.Text:
はい　ゆっくり息を吸って～
吐いて～

English.Text: Slowly now... Breathe in... And out...

Japanese.Text:
安心して……
怖くない　怖くないですよ

English.Text: There, there. Just relax. Nothing to be afraid of.

Japanese.Text: 落ち着いて　大丈夫よ

English.Text: Just relax... You're alright...

Japanese.Text:
つらいね　苦しいね
そばにいるから安心してね

English.Text: You must be in so much pain. Don't worry, I'm here for you.

Japanese.Text: ひと休みして　落ち着きましょう

English.Text: Let's take a little break and try again, alright?

Japanese.Text: なんだ？　面倒を起こすなよ

English.Text: Don't go causin' trouble. You hear me?

Japanese.Text: おい　仕事の邪魔はするな

English.Text: Stay out of our way. Understood?

Japanese.Text: つまんねえ任務させやがって

English.Text: What a shit job to get stuck with.

Japanese.Text: 黒マントにはなりたくねえよな

English.Text: Hope I never wind up a freak like them.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントたちの
お守りをしてやってんだよ

English.Text: Been bustin' my hump lookin' after those...weirdos.

Japanese.Text: くそ　気が滅入るぜ……

English.Text: Damn... This job's depressing.

Japanese.Text: よそ者か……

English.Text: Travelers, huh?

Japanese.Text: 用が済んだら帰ってくれ

English.Text: Get what you need, then leave.

Japanese.Text: なにしに来たんだ

English.Text: What're they doin' here?

Japanese.Text: ここには　なにもないよ

English.Text: There's nothing here, y'know.

Japanese.Text: 悪いね　いま忙しいんだ

English.Text: Not now. I'm...kinda busy.

Japanese.Text: なんの用かな？

English.Text: What do you want?

Japanese.Text: ああ　いやだわ

English.Text: Ugh, visitors...

Japanese.Text: ほっといて

English.Text: Go away.

Japanese.Text: お話しすることはありません

English.Text: I don't have anything to say to you.

Japanese.Text: ここのことは忘れてください

English.Text: Just forget what you saw here.

Japanese.Text:
ここはニブルヘイム
この村に　なんの用だ？

English.Text: This is Nibelheim. You got some business here?

Japanese.Text:
こんなところまで旅してくるなんて
物好きだな

English.Text: You're an odd one to come out to the middle of nowhere like this.

Japanese.Text:
この村は神羅カンパニーが管理している
魔晄中毒の人たちの
療養所になってるんだ

English.Text: This town is under the jurisdiction of Shinra. It has been converted into a treatment center for mako poisoning.

Japanese.Text:
療養者に面会なら
診療棟で聞いてくれ

English.Text: If you're here to see a patient, ask a caretaker.

Japanese.Text:
療養者が村の外に出ないように
見張ってるんだが

English.Text: It's our job to ensure patients don't wander out.

Japanese.Text:
最近は新しく入ってくるヤツも多いし
勝手に抜け出すヤツも多くてな

English.Text: But it's been difficult to keep track of them, what with the recent surge of admissions.

Japanese.Text: 正直　人手が足りてないよ

English.Text: Honestly, we're understaffed.

Japanese.Text:
ニブルヘイムは軍が調査中だ
用が済んだら　すぐに立ち去れ！

English.Text: An official investigation is underway here. Do what you need to do, then leave.

Japanese.Text:
ニブルヘイムは軍の管理下にある
居住者でなければ　長居はするなよ

English.Text: The military has assumed direct control of Nibelheim. Non-residents are asked to limit their stay.

Japanese.Text:
あれ　お客さん面会ですかい？
ここは軽症の療養者が入ってる棟ですよ

English.Text: Hey there. Let me guess: here to visit someone? This is where they keep the patients who have milder cases.

Japanese.Text:
療養のみなさん
いつもはおとなしいんだが
最近　急に暴れ出すようになってね

English.Text: Usually they don't make too much of a fuss, but something's got them all riled up lately. No idea what, though.

Japanese.Text:
いままでこんなことなかったから
なにかあるんじゃないかと心配でさ

English.Text: Still, there's gotta be a reason for it. They've never acted like this before.

Japanese.Text:
ご家族だか　お友達に会っていくなら
しっかり元気づけてやっておくれよ

English.Text: Anyhow, don't know if you're here for family or a friend, but I'm sure they'll be glad to see you.

Japanese.Text:
療養所で使う食材は
神羅から定期的に届くんですよ

English.Text: The food we serve to our patients is shipped to us from company facilities.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄中毒っていったって
料理の味くらいはわかると思うしね

English.Text: The stuff we get isn't bad per se, but we try to make it as appetizing as we can.

Japanese.Text:
せめて　美味しいものを
食べさせてあげたいよ

English.Text: Their taste buds still work fine, after all.

Japanese.Text:
療養者のみなさんには
自由に行動してもらっています

English.Text: We allow our patients to walk around─for their health and well-being.

Japanese.Text:
むやみに近づかないでくださいね
他人との接触を
怖がってしまう人もいるんで

English.Text: Please try to give them some space. Many are still uncomfortable with physical contact.

Japanese.Text: 最近　みなさん元気がいいんですよ

English.Text: It's reassuring to see them become more active.

Japanese.Text:
これまでは１日中じっとしていることが
多かったんですけどね

English.Text: Until recently, they used to stand around all day doing nothing.

Japanese.Text:
口にする言葉も
変わったような気がします
回復の兆しだと良いんだけど

English.Text: They've even started to form actual words. That might be the first real sign of progress.

Japanese.Text:
もともと村にいた療養者に加えて
最近は　村の外からも
たくさんの黒マントが来て
居着いてしまってるんです

English.Text: As if our current patients weren't enough to deal with, more sick people keep wandering in from outside the village. Where are they even coming from?

Japanese.Text: 魔晄中毒の人が増えているのかしら

English.Text: Are we seeing some sort of epidemic?

Japanese.Text:
これ以上増えてしまうと
私たちだけじゃ
手に負えないかもしれません

English.Text: Not sure what we'll do if this continues. We barely have enough staff as is.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントの人たち　最近ハッキリと
言葉を発するようになったんです

English.Text: I'm not entirely sure why, but lately, some of the patients have started talking.

Japanese.Text:
『リユニオン』
そう言ってるように聞こえます

English.Text: They all keep saying "reunion" over and over.

Japanese.Text:
いったい　なにを
伝えたいのでしょうか？

English.Text: What in the world are they trying to tell us?

Japanese.Text:
療養者たちの発作の原因は
わかったのか？

English.Text: Still no idea what triggers their spasms?

Japanese.Text:
いえ　医療班もまだ
特定できないそうです

English.Text: None. The medical team is at a complete loss.

Japanese.Text: 原因がわかれば　対処もできるんだがな

English.Text: If only we could treat the underlying cause...

Japanese.Text:
力まかせに押さえるだけじゃ
体がもたない

English.Text: But until we can, just have to hold 'em down.

Japanese.Text: 昼も夜も気が抜けませんしね

English.Text: What, for twenty-four hours a day?

Japanese.Text:
介護スタッフの増員を
頼んでみましょうか

English.Text: Maybe we should ask for additional staff.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントのための新しい設備を
計画してるらしいぞ

English.Text: I hear they're planning on building a new facility for the patients.

Japanese.Text:
モデオヘイムにあった温泉を
提案してみないか？

English.Text: Whaddaya say we push for a hot spring?

Japanese.Text:
あの現場は寒くて最悪の環境だったけど
源泉かけ流しの温泉だけは
最高だったよな

English.Text: Like the one in Modeoheim? Man, that thing was a little slice of heaven in the heart of a cold hell.

Japanese.Text:
広い風呂なら　入浴介助も
やりやすいだろうな

English.Text: If we get a big one, it'll be easier to help the patients in.

Japanese.Text:
あったかい湯にゆったり浸かれば
黒マントだって喜ぶに違いない

English.Text: A long, relaxing soak would be therapeutic for just about anyone.

Japanese.Text: 黒マントさんが　こ～ろんだ！

English.Text: Three, two, one─robeman!

Japanese.Text: 黒マントさんが　こ～ろんだ！

English.Text: Three, two, one─robeman!

Japanese.Text:
黒いマントは
魔晄中毒の患者さん向けの
神羅の支給品なんですよ

English.Text: So those creepy outfits you see all the patients wearing? The company doles 'em out for free.

Japanese.Text:
わざと近寄りがたい雰囲気に
してるんですかね？

English.Text: Probably to encourage people to keep their distance.

Japanese.Text:
もっとキレイにしてあげたいんですけど
最近は患者さんが増えたんで
手がまわりません

English.Text: They could all use a good scrubbing, if you ask me, but no time for that. Too many patients to look after.

Japanese.Text:
ああ　オレも黒マントを着て
ずっとボーッとしていたい……

English.Text: ...If only I could don a set of robes and just...space out all day...

Japanese.Text: 私　昔のニブルヘイムを知ってるんだよ

English.Text: You know I came up around here, way back in the day.

Japanese.Text:
村の建物もどこか違うようだし
住んでいた人たち
どこへ行っちゃったんだい？

English.Text: It's strange. None of the buildings look like I remember. And where did all the people who used to live here go?

Japanese.Text:
引っ越し先を聞いても
だれも教えてくれないんだ

English.Text: I keep asking who moved where, but no one will tell me anything.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントたちは
うちの菜園の野菜が好物なんだよ

English.Text: Don't know why, but those robed people really love the veggies from my garden.

Japanese.Text:
あいつらが　すこしでも回復するように
介護する日々だ

English.Text: We're doin' what we can to help those guys get back on their feet.

Japanese.Text: 終わりは見えねえけどな

English.Text: It's never enough though.

Japanese.Text:
毎日忙しいな
今日は医療班の手伝いをするんだ

English.Text: Gotta lend the medical team a hand today... I can't catch a break!

Japanese.Text:
日が高いうちに
診察棟の掃除でもしよっと

English.Text: Should prob'ly get to tidyin' up the rooms while there's still daylight.

Japanese.Text:
オレの任期は　あと半年だ
せいいっぱい働くぜ

English.Text: Another six months and I'm outta here. Hope I can end on a high note.

Japanese.Text:
ここに来てからは
みんな健康に暮らせているの

English.Text: Living out here in the country has done wonders for my health.

Japanese.Text:
あたしはミッドガルから
移住してきたのよ

English.Text: I only just moved here from Midgar, actually.

Japanese.Text: あっ　これって秘密だっけ？

English.Text: Wait, am I allowed to say that?

Japanese.Text:
ここに来たおかげで
毎日ゆっくり過ごせてる

English.Text: Life is so much more relaxed here. I love it.

Japanese.Text: この暮らしが　ずっと続けばいいのに

English.Text: If only things could always be so peaceful...

Japanese.Text:
介護の仕事はキツイけど
やりがいはあるよ

English.Text: Being a caretaker isn't easy, but it is rewarding.

Japanese.Text:
なんにも悪くないのに
あんな状態なんて　かわいそう

English.Text: I feel so bad for these people. They did nothing to deserve this.

Japanese.Text:
すこしは人間味のある暮らしを
してもらいたいの

English.Text: I hope I can help to make their lives a little bit easier.

Japanese.Text:
僕はミッドガルでも　黒マントたちの
お世話をしていたんですよ

English.Text: I actually used to look after these people when I lived in Midgar too.

Japanese.Text:
あの頃はボランティアだったんですけど
ここじゃ給料がもらえるんで
報われてます

English.Text: Was only a volunteer back then, but now I get paid a decent salary. Lucky me, huh?

Japanese.Text:
ほら　ここって
遊ぶ場所もないでしょ？

English.Text: Best part is: there isn't a single thing to do around here.

Japanese.Text:
ほぼ貯金にまわせるから
帰る頃には潤っちゃいますね

English.Text: Which means all that gil goes straight into savings. I'm gonna be rich!

Japanese.Text:
優しく撫でてあげてね
ネコちゃんに触るとほっこりするわよね

English.Text: Be gentle, now. Isn't she nice and soft? Makes you feel fuzzy on the inside too, huh?

Japanese.Text:
ネコがゴロゴロいってるでしょ？
喜んでるんだよ　ありがとうってね

English.Text: Do you know what that purring means? It means that she's happy. She's saying, "Thank you for the pets!"

Japanese.Text:
あいつらって
優しく話しかけても反応ないし
やる気なくなっちゃうな

English.Text: All we do is bend over backwards for these people, and what do we get? Grunts.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄中毒なんだから仕方ないって
任期が終わるまで我慢しようぜ

English.Text: What did you expect? They're mako poisoned. Just hang in there until your term's up, okay?

Japanese.Text:
誰かが面倒みてあげないと
生きられないことは
わかっちゃいるんだけど

English.Text: I know, I know. They can't survive without us looking after them, but...

Japanese.Text:
なんのために生かしてるんだ
っていう話だよな

English.Text: Hey, I get it. Like, why even bother, right?

Japanese.Text:
いっそのこと楽にしてやったら
幸せなんじゃないかとか考えちゃうよ

English.Text: To be honest, sometimes I wonder if it'd be kinder to just put them out of their misery.

Japanese.Text:
ニブル山のモンスターが
このあたりまで降りてくるから
気をつけろよ

English.Text: Careful out there. Fiends've started coming down off the mountain.

Japanese.Text: 黒マントたちがおびえてる

English.Text: The patients're all worked up.

Japanese.Text:
こんな日は
モンスターも増える気がするんだ

English.Text: I'm thinkin' we might have monster trouble today...

Japanese.Text:
村の外に
黒マントたちが出ていかないように
見張ってるんです

English.Text: We keep watch to make sure the patients don't wander off into the wilderness.

Japanese.Text:
外に出るなら　お気をつけて
村の外でなにかあっても
助けには行けませんから

English.Text: Are you heading out? Then be careful. We won't be able to come to the rescue if anything should happen to you.

Japanese.Text: なんだ？

English.Text: What?

Japanese.Text:
ニブル魔晄炉周辺は軍が調査中だ
面倒を起こすなよ

English.Text: The area around the reactor is currently under investigation. So steer clear.

Japanese.Text:
この村は
黒マントの収容所になってるんだな

English.Text: Guess this is where they keep all those black-robed freaks.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　見なかったことにするけどよ
俺たちは言われた仕事を片付けるだけだ

English.Text: ...A fact I'm gonna forget the minute I'm gone. I'm here to do a job─and not to talk about it.

Japanese.Text:
ここでは居住者の生活全般の
サポートをおこなっております

English.Text: The services we provide here are strictly for the benefit of our residents.

Japanese.Text:
すみませんが
旅の方のお役には立てないかと

English.Text: Unfortunately, we're not in a position to assist travelers.

Japanese.Text: お引き取りをお願いいたします

English.Text: I'm going to have to ask you to leave.

Japanese.Text:
窓口の対応は
相変わらずノロいな……

English.Text: Ugh, c'mon... Can't they speed it up a little?

Japanese.Text:
モンスターの死骸の片付けを
頼みたくてね

English.Text: Someone needs to clean up all those fiend carcasses.

Japanese.Text:
入植管理者のフォーリーさんが
出張中らしくて　話が通じないよ

English.Text: Everything's going extra slow because Nick's away on some business trip.

Japanese.Text:
ミッドガルの偉い人が動かないと
お手上げよね

English.Text: I hate that we need Midgar's approval for every little thing.

Japanese.Text:
本社がゴタついてるらしくて
対応がいつも以上に遅いわ

English.Text: Head office is in turmoil, so requests are being processed slower than usual.

Japanese.Text:
任期短縮の相談したいんだけど
相手にしてもらえないのよ

English.Text: I was hoping to shorten my tenure here, but I guess that's not in the cards.

Japanese.Text:
故郷の母を呼び寄せたいんだ
身内は同居していいんでしょ？

English.Text: My mom needs to move in with me. I know you allow that for immediate family.

Japanese.Text:
ですから　途中増員の審査には
時間がかかりまして　結果が出る頃には
あなたの任期も満了です

English.Text: Like I told you before, by the time we've finished running her mandatory background check, your term here will already be up.

Japanese.Text:
じゃあ　報酬を前借りさせてよ
せめて仕送りしなきゃ

English.Text: Then can I at least get an advance on my salary so I can send her the gil she needs?

Japanese.Text:
いえ　任期満了時という決まりです
融資なら対応できますが……

English.Text: All contracts are paid out at the end of term. I can offer you a loan, but...

Japanese.Text: 彼は　ここが好きみたいなんです

English.Text: He seems to like it here for some reason.

Japanese.Text:
働いてるつもりのようで
昔のこと　思い出してるんでしょうか

English.Text: It's almost like he's...trying to work? Maybe he had a similar job in the past.

Japanese.Text:
いけません　部外者がこんな所まで！
ここはムラサキ課長の執務室です

English.Text: This area's off-limits to civilians! This is the deputy commissioner's office. You're definitely not allowed back here!

Japanese.Text:
ああ　でも見なかったことにします
定時退社がかかってるんで

English.Text: Actually...you know what? I'll just pretend I didn't see anything. That way I can go home on time!

Japanese.Text:
見えてない
な～んにも見えてないですよ

English.Text: No one here but us Shinra employees. No siree Bob!

Japanese.Text: だから　どうか早々にお引き取りを

English.Text: Please, you really need to leave before I get in trouble.

Japanese.Text: さあ　今日中に仕事を片付けるぞ～！

English.Text: Just finishing up for the day! Not breaking any rules!

Japanese.Text:
ムラサキ課長
事件に巻き込まれて殉職されたそうです

English.Text: We've been informed that Mr. Murasaki was killed during some kind of incident...

Japanese.Text:
面倒見のいい方だったのに
残念です

English.Text: He was such a good boss too... I'll miss him.

Japanese.Text:
神羅屋敷から
女の声が聞こえるんだってさ

English.Text: Sometimes you can hear a woman's voice coming from the manor...

Japanese.Text:
むかし住んでた女の幽霊じゃないかって
噂になってる

English.Text: It's the ghost of someone who used to live there a long time ago.

Japanese.Text:
静かな村だったのに
最近　おかしなことばかり起こるよね

English.Text: Ghosts. Great. And to think this town used to be so peaceful...

Japanese.Text: あの屋敷は呪われてるって噂もあるよな

English.Text: Apparently there's this horrible curse on the place too.

Japanese.Text:
ニブル山の先は
死の国だって伝承もあるのよね？

English.Text: According to legend, the land of the dead is just beyond Mt. Nibel.

Japanese.Text:
もしかして変な所と繋がってるのかな
ああ　怖い！

English.Text: Wait─maybe that means the mansion was, like, built on the gates of hell or something! Oh god!

Japanese.Text:
神羅屋敷の女の声が
聞こえなくなったらしい

English.Text: Have you guys heard any voices from Shinra Manor lately?

Japanese.Text:
管理人さんが
なにか対応してくれたのかな

English.Text: No, actually... Maybe the supervisor dealt with it?

Japanese.Text: あの屋敷の噂は　謎のままか

English.Text: I guess we'll never know the truth behind those rumors now, huh?

Japanese.Text: うん　でも近寄ると危ない

English.Text: Honestly? That is fine by me.

Japanese.Text:
この村には　いくつも不思議があるけど
触れちゃいけない領域なんだと思うな

English.Text: I get the feeling that this town has a lot of weird, creepy mysteries that are better off forgotten.

Japanese.Text:
旅の方ですか？
急患ではないですよね

English.Text: You certainly don't look ill. Passing through, I take it?

Japanese.Text:
具合が悪いなら　療養者の定期健診が
終わった後からの対応となります

English.Text: If you are feeling unwell, though, you'll have to wait. We need to tend to our current patients first.

Japanese.Text:
ここは診療棟です
療養者の診察と治療をおこなっています

English.Text: This is where we care for the patients. We provide checkups, treatments─whatever they need.

Japanese.Text:
療養者への面会なら
申し訳ないですが　直接探してください

English.Text: If you're here to visit someone, I'm afraid you'll have to track them down yourself. We're a bit busy.

Japanese.Text:
最近　療養者が増えてまして
日中の活動場所まで
把握できてないんですよ

English.Text: We've been dealing with so many new patients lately. It's impossible to keep tabs on everyone at all times.

Japanese.Text:
ここは診療棟ですが
いまは　休憩時間です

English.Text: Oh, welcome. I'm afraid the staff is on break at the moment.

Japanese.Text:
料理長のダーエさんなら
２階にいますよ

English.Text: If you're looking for Christine, she's upstairs.

Japanese.Text: 大丈夫よ　ちょっと我慢してね～

English.Text: Don't worry. It'll all be over soon.

Japanese.Text: 昨日と同じよ　安心してね

English.Text: Just the same thing we did yesterday.

Japanese.Text:
はい　ご苦労さま
お大事に

English.Text: There, all done. Take care!

Japanese.Text:
はい　異常なし
また明日

English.Text: You're good to go. See you tomorrow!

Japanese.Text: はい　先生の前にどうぞ

English.Text: Alright, the doctor will see you now.

Japanese.Text: 怖くないですよ

English.Text: It'll be okay.

Japanese.Text:
お引き取りください
重症者の部屋です

English.Text: This room is for patients in critical condition.

Japanese.Text:
もう　長くはなさそうなんです
そっとしてあげてください

English.Text: Please just let them rest. They don't have much longer as it is.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントの人たちの腕には
イレズミでナンバーが彫られてるんです

English.Text: You might've noticed how some of our patients have number tattoos on their arms.

Japanese.Text:
でも　ナンバーがない人もいて
症状にも違いがあるのかもしれません

English.Text: I'm not sure why that is, myself. Maybe it's to mark ones with different symptoms?

Japanese.Text:
私たち医療班が日々観察していくことで
なにかがわかればいいんですけど

English.Text: You'd think someone would brief us on these things, considering we're the ones who actually have to look after them.

Japanese.Text:
わわっ　ここは療養者のみなさんの
お食事をまかなう調理棟です

English.Text: Oh, uh, h-hello! Sorry, but we're busy trying to make food for all the patients.

Japanese.Text:
最近　外から来て
居着いてしまう黒マントが多くて
やりくりが大変なんですよ

English.Text: A whole bunch of those robed people just showed up out of nowhere. We've been struggling to keep up ever since!

Japanese.Text:
でも　創意と工夫を重ねて
１日３食しっかり提供しています！

English.Text: Oh─don't you worry, though! We're still making sure all our patients get three square meals a day.

Japanese.Text:
あっ　ダーエさんなら
診療棟にお弁当を届けに行ってますよ

English.Text: Oh─if it's Christine you're after, she's out delivering lunches.

Japanese.Text:
料理長のおかげで
毎日楽しく仕事できています！

English.Text: I just love our head chef. She always keeps things interesting around here!

Japanese.Text:
わたしも料理長みたいに
いつでもどこでもおおらかにありたいわ

English.Text: Seriously. I hope I can learn to be as coolheaded as her someday.

Japanese.Text:
あんた　ここにむかし住んでた人だろ？
面倒は起こさないでおくれよ

English.Text: You used to live here a long time ago, right? We'd appreciate it if you didn't cause us any trouble.

Japanese.Text: ふん　まあ欲しけりゃ売ってやるよ

English.Text: Fine, if you're that desperate to buy something...

Japanese.Text: 言いたかないけど　もう来ないでほしいね

English.Text: It's nothing personal, but...you shouldn't come back.

Japanese.Text:
あんたの故郷は　もうないよ
忘れるほうがいい

English.Text: This isn't your home anymore. Remember that, alright?

Japanese.Text:
この人は　きっと
買い物好きだったんでしょうね

English.Text: She must've loved going shopping when she was well.

Japanese.Text:
家族か　恋人か……
誰かのために買い物をしていた日々を
思い出してるのかな

English.Text: Maybe not for herself, but for others. Buying little trinkets and gifts for her family, or a partner.

Japanese.Text: しんら～？

English.Text: You're Shinra?

Japanese.Text: ちんら～？

English.Text: Chinra?

Japanese.Text: カッコイー！

English.Text: You're so cool!

Japanese.Text: カッキー！

English.Text: You so cool!

Japanese.Text: ソルジャ？

English.Text: You a SOLDIER?

Japanese.Text: そるざ？

English.Text: You a shoulder?

Japanese.Text: 黒マント　なおすの？

English.Text: You gonna fix those robe folks?

Japanese.Text: なおすの？

English.Text: You gonna fix 'em?

Japanese.Text: いらっしゃいませ　休憩されますか？

English.Text: Welcome. Would you like a room?

Japanese.Text: 良い旅を

English.Text: Safe travels.

Japanese.Text:
なんだよ　この村
どこも黒マントだらけだな

English.Text: What's with this place? People in black robes everywhere you look.

Japanese.Text: 明日は魔晄炉調査なんだ

English.Text: Need to focus on tomorrow's survey.

Japanese.Text:
ここの魔晄炉って初期型だろ？
まさかこの目で見れる日が来るなんてな

English.Text: The reactor here's one of the oldest models, I think. Never thought I'd get to see it for myself.

Japanese.Text: ウータイとの戦争　始まるのかな

English.Text: Wutai wouldn't fight us over a backwater like this, right?

Japanese.Text:
療養者のリハビリのための運動なんだが
なかなか　できるようにならなくてね

English.Text: I understand this is supposed to be a form of physical therapy, but they really seem to be struggling with it.

Japanese.Text:
ザンガンっていう武闘家が
考案した体操らしいです

English.Text: Some martial artist named Zangan came up with this exercise.

Japanese.Text: くわしい由来は知りませんけど

English.Text: That's what everyone tells me, at least.

Japanese.Text: ニブル魔晄炉は封鎖中だ

English.Text: The reactor is off-limits.

Japanese.Text: なにしに来た　捕まりたいのか？

English.Text: You want to be arrested? Beat it!

Japanese.Text: ここは神羅の管理区域ですよ

English.Text: You're in Shinra territory now.

Japanese.Text:
はあ……
海を泳いで故郷に帰れればな

English.Text: Ocean feels a lot bigger when your family's waiting on the other side.

Japanese.Text:
村で黒マントの世話をするより
ここの業務のほうが気が楽だよ

English.Text: I'll take shipping duty any day over looking after our patients.

Japanese.Text:
黒マントの人たちも
たまにこの港に流れ着くの

English.Text: You never know what the tide'll bring in─or who.

Japanese.Text:
倉庫は空よ
もう村に運んじゃったから

English.Text: Don't bother checking the warehouses. Everything's already been shipped.

Japanese.Text:
神羅の定期便
だんだん質が下がってる気がするのよね

English.Text: Is it just me or have the shipments been dropping in quality lately?

Japanese.Text: うう　ああ……

English.Text: Erg... Unh...

Japanese.Text: クイーンズ……ブラッド

English.Text: Queen's...Blood...

Japanese.Text: バウト……

English.Text: Play...me...

Japanese.Text: うう　ああ……

English.Text: Hrng...ahh...

Japanese.Text: ほら　デイルさん　ダメですよ

English.Text: No, Dale. Leave the man alone.

Japanese.Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドなら
私が　相手になってあげるから

English.Text: I can play Queen's Blood with you, if that's what you want, okay?

Japanese.Text: ごめんなさいね

English.Text: I'm so sorry.

Japanese.Text:
この人は　デイルさんっていうんだけど
カードバウトがすごく好きでね

English.Text: This is Dale. He loves playing Queen's Blood more than anything else in the world.

Japanese.Text:
そうだ　もしよかったらあなた
デイルさんの相手になってあげてくれない？

English.Text: Actually...I don't suppose you would mind playing a match or two with him─just real quick?

Japanese.Text:
どうも　私だと弱すぎるみたいで
強いバウターを探してたのよ

English.Text: I'm not the best player, so I think he's been looking for someone who'll give him more of a challenge.

Japanese.Text: 手があいた時でいいから　バウトしてあげてね

English.Text: That's fine. Come back if you ever have a moment though!

Japanese.Text: うう　ああ……

English.Text: Hrnh... Urg...

Japanese.Text: カードバウト……

English.Text: Queen's Blood...

Japanese.Text: ああ……

English.Text: Ung...ahhh...

Japanese.Text:
うんうん　強いバウターと戦えて
すごく喜んでるみたい

English.Text: Oh wow... I don't think I've ever seen him this happy. It must've been a great match.

Japanese.Text:
くろ……べに……
じょお……まじょ……

English.Text: Shadow...blood... Queen... Witch...

Japanese.Text: ほら　あんまり引き止めちゃダメですよ

English.Text: That's enough, Dale. He has other things to do, I'm sure.

Japanese.Text: 助かったわ　戦ってくれてありがとね

English.Text: Thank you so much for taking the time to play with him.

Japanese.Text: へえ　デイルさんって本当に強いのね

English.Text: Oh... I hadn't realized Dale was so talented.

Japanese.Text: あなたなら　私でも勝てそう

English.Text: Honestly, I bet even I could beat you.

Japanese.Text:
最後まで勝敗がわからなくて
ドキドキしちゃった

English.Text: Wow, that went right down to the wire! It had me on the edge of my seat.

Japanese.Text:
私も　デイルさんとやりあえるように
もっと勉強しないと

English.Text: I should try to learn a thing or two from you, so I can be a better opponent for Dale.

Japanese.Text:
デイルさんに代わって　感謝するわね
ありがとう

English.Text: Dale can't talk, but I know how grateful he is. Thank you.

Japanese.Text:
よし　隊長はいない
いまならバウトができそうだな

English.Text: Okay, the captain's nowhere in sight. Which means I can play Queen's Blood!

Japanese.Text:
点呼まで　まだ時間がある
サボるならいまだ

English.Text: I've gotta make the most of my time before roll call starts...

Japanese.Text:
私のサボりにつきあってくれる
勇気あるバウターはいないものか

English.Text: The question is: is there anyone out there who's brave enough to slack off with me?

Japanese.Text: おまえは……！

English.Text: ...You!

Japanese.Text: もしかして　カードバウターか？

English.Text: You don't happen to be a card player, do you!?

Japanese.Text: 私にはわかるぞ

English.Text: It's no use denying it.

Japanese.Text:
おまえも　やるべきことを放り出し
クイーンズ・ブラッドにいそしむ者だな

English.Text: You're slacking off because you wanna play Queen's Blood─because you're just like me!

Japanese.Text:
ふふふ　心配するな
私も同類だ

English.Text: I won't tell if you won't. Comrade.

Japanese.Text: 私は『サボりの達人ターナー』

English.Text: The name's Turner, the top truant.

Japanese.Text: 任務なんかクソくらえ　サボりこそが人生

English.Text: I say screw working! I'm all about playin' hooky!

Japanese.Text:
昇進をドブに捨て　左遷されてもなお
サボり続けて磨いたこの腕

English.Text: You'd be hard-pressed to find anyone who's better at it than me! I don't give a damn about demotions!

Japanese.Text: とくと　味わうがいい！

English.Text: Prepare yourself!

Japanese.Text: どうした　サボらないのか？

English.Text: You're not gonna blow off work with me?

Japanese.Text: 任務中にやるバウトほど　面白いものはない

English.Text: Playing while you should be working makes it more fun.

Japanese.Text:
いいか　私がサボっていることは
他言無用だぞ

English.Text: Remember: these companies don't deserve shit. Screw 'em all.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄炉のことで調査隊が来ているが
私は動じない

English.Text: Heard they sent a survey team to check out the reactor. Not that I care.

Japanese.Text: 毅然とサボり続けてみせる

English.Text: Nothing'll force me to work!

Japanese.Text: なんという腕だ

English.Text: That was impressive.

Japanese.Text:
任務中に大会に出場して優勝したこともある
この私に苦杯をなめさせるとは

English.Text: I didn't think you'd beat me so easily. When I entered contests on the clock, I always won.

Japanese.Text: まさか　私よりもサボっているというのか？

English.Text: Wait... Could you be more of a slacker than me?

Japanese.Text:
私は　点呼以外のすべての時間を
カードバウトに捧げているんだぞ！

English.Text: But I devote all my time outside of roll calls specifically to playing Queen's Blood!

Japanese.Text: もしかして　おまえ……無職なのか？

English.Text: Oh, I see... You're unemployed. Living the dream!

Japanese.Text:
深くは追及しないでおこう
上には上がいるということだ

English.Text:
No, that's none of my business.
You're a bigger fish. That's all.

Japanese.Text:
貴殿と戦えたことを誇りに思う
また挑戦させてくれ

English.Text: It was an honor to have played with you. I hope I'll have another chance someday.

Japanese.Text: もっと真剣にサボらないと　私には勝てないぞ

English.Text: You'll never beat me until you become a better slacker.

Japanese.Text: サボりが足りないんじゃないか？

English.Text: You need to slack off more.

Japanese.Text: やるじゃないか　しびれたよ

English.Text: You really gave me a run for my money.

Japanese.Text: もっとサボって　腕を磨かなければ

English.Text: I need to work harder at slacking off.

Japanese.Text:
サボりは１日にしてならず
もっと精進するよ

English.Text: You might be even more committed than me to the truant lifestyle.

Japanese.Text:
すごいことになりました！
ついに『鬼才の写真家』として認定されたようです

English.Text: Here's something that oughta brighten your day: the Association has bumped you up a rank. Congratulations!

Japanese.Text: これは　いつか個展を開くしかありません

English.Text: Honestly, you really oughta show off your work.

Japanese.Text:
あなたの作品が
世界をめぐっている様子が目に浮かびます

English.Text: It bespeaks a beautiful finesse─never seen anything like it.

Japanese.Text: ぜひ　多くの人に見てもらいたいですね

English.Text: Some might say it belongs in a gallery!

Japanese.Text: あれが　ニブル山……

English.Text: So that's Mt. Nibel.

Japanese.Text: 噂には聞いていたが　独特な形だな

English.Text: It cuts a rather stern and imposing figure.

Japanese.Text:
禍々しい稜線によって切り裂かれた空
まるで幻想的な絵画のようだ

English.Text: The ragged ridges jutting into the sky... Like something out of a fantastical painting.

Japanese.Text:
療養施設の背後にあるニブル山
なんとも異様な光景だな

English.Text: I can't imagine the folks in those treatment centers sleep easy with Mt. Nibel looming behind them.

Japanese.Text:
またお会いしましたね　では
黒マントのみなさんといっしょに　記念に１枚

English.Text: Oh, what a pleasant surprise. Say, why don't you and those robed folks pose for a photo?

Japanese.Text:
ここは　神羅カンパニーが管轄している
療養所のようですね

English.Text: It turns out that Shinra's in charge of the treatment facilities here.

Japanese.Text: 申請して　なんとか撮影の許可を取りました

English.Text: Getting permission to take pictures was not easy.

Japanese.Text:
ただ……撮った写真はすべてチェックし
場合によっては　没収するとのことです

English.Text: All my photos will be reviewed─and if Shinra sees something they don't like, it's theirs.

Japanese.Text:
まあ　いい写真を撮れば
きっと大丈夫でしょう

English.Text: Just gotta impress those suits with some nice shots.

Japanese.Text:
では　オススメ撮影スポットが見つかったら
教えてくださいね

English.Text: If you find a good photo spot, don't hesitate to let me know.

Japanese.Text: 私の目的はズバリ　あのニブル山です

English.Text: Today's target is none other than Mt. Nibel.

Japanese.Text:
鳥肌が立つほどに奇妙なあの形は唯一無二
眺めているだけで　ゾクゾクしますよね

English.Text: No other natural formation can inspire so much dread. Just looking at it gives me goose bumps!

Japanese.Text:
せっかくニブルヘイムまで足を運んだので
ほかにもいろいろと撮影するつもりです

English.Text: Gonna get some shots around town too. Not every day I visit Nibelheim.

Japanese.Text: 良い撮影スポットがあったら　教えてくださいね

English.Text: If you find a place worth shooting, gimme a holler.

Japanese.Text:
オススメ撮影スポットを
見つけてくれたんですね　ありがとうございます

English.Text: Hey there. Thank you for tracking down that spot. Quite the view you captured.

Japanese.Text:
ここは　世界で初めて魔晄炉ができた場所なのに
神羅はなぜ　療養所にしたんでしょうね？

English.Text: I'm surprised they made the home of the world's first reactor a treatment center rather than a tourist trap.

Japanese.Text:
観光地にしたほうが儲かりそうなのに
それに建物が妙に新しいのも気になります

English.Text: And the buildings here look pretty new despite the town's age. Doesn't that strike you as a bit odd?

Japanese.Text: なにか　重大な秘密が隠されているのでしょうか？

English.Text: What sort of secrets do you think Shinra's hiding here?

Japanese.Text:
ふふ　こうやって被写体の中に秘められたドラマを
想像するのも　撮影の醍醐味ですよね

English.Text: It's probably nothing─but getting the imagination going is part of what makes photography fun.

Japanese.Text:
近くに　神羅屋敷と呼ばれる建物があるのですが
そこだけ撮影の許可がおりなかったんですよ

English.Text: I managed to get permission to take pictures of every place in town except for one: Shinra Manor.

Japanese.Text: 写真が神羅に没収されないといいのですが

English.Text: Hopefully none of my shots get me in trouble.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんも
チョコボについて学びに来られたんですか？

English.Text:
Oh, Cloud! Have you come to brush up
on your bird handling?

Japanese.Text:
伝説のチョコボ仙人が隠居されていると聞いて
ボクも来てみたのですが

English.Text: As soon as I heard the legendary chocobo sage was here, I knew I had to come.

Japanese.Text:
想像していたよりも　豪勢なお屋敷で
びっくりしています

English.Text: I was surprised to see a recluse residing in such luxury...

Japanese.Text: まさか　プール付きとは……

English.Text: Even hermits enjoy a dip in the pool.

Japanese.Text: ニブルのチョコボは興味深いですね

English.Text: Nibelheim chocobos are fascinating.

Japanese.Text:
海の上を駆けたり飛んだりするチョコボなんて
ほかの土地には存在しません

English.Text: While several breeds can fly, water-walking is a feat unique to this one.

Japanese.Text:
仙人がニブルに住むことに決めたのも
海チョコボがいるからかもしれませんね

English.Text: Perhaps the chocobo sage chose this location in order to study these special birds.

Japanese.Text:
チョコボ仙人は　ブリーダーとしてだけでなく
騎手としても一流だったと聞きます

English.Text: I've heard the sage was not only an accomplished breeder, but a talented jockey as well.

Japanese.Text:
仙人が　チョコボの活用法を確立したおかげで
現代の繁栄があるとも言われています

English.Text: Some even say his efforts were instrumental in the development of the modern chocobo industry!

Japanese.Text: 本当にすごい人……なんですよね

English.Text: If that is to be believed, he's a remarkable man indeed.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
『チョコボ草』はご存知ですか？

English.Text: Cloud, are you familiar with chocograss?

Japanese.Text:
太陽光により発生した上昇気流を利用し
フワフワと浮かんでいる　不思議な草なのですが

English.Text: It's an unusual plant, often seen floating along warm updrafts generated by solar energy.

Japanese.Text: 研究者がおらず　詳細はわかっていません

English.Text: Little else is known, though, due to a lack of research.

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん　第一人者になってみませんか？

English.Text: Well? Care to blaze the scientific trail?

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
ここは　魔晄中毒者の保養所のようです

English.Text: I hear this village is a treatment facility for mako poisoning...

Japanese.Text: 黒マントのみなさんが多く滞在されています

English.Text: which explains the abundance of robed patients.

Japanese.Text: これまでに見た黒マントの方々も

English.Text: To see so many in one place...

Japanese.Text:
もしかしたら　この村を目指して
旅をされていたのかもしれませんね

English.Text: Perhaps those we met previously were making a pilgrimage to this town?

Japanese.Text: ニブル山は不気味な形状をしていますね

English.Text: Mt. Nibel strikes an imposing figure.

Japanese.Text:
根を張る植物が少なく
落石や崩落が多いと聞きます

English.Text: Without plants to stabilize the soil, the mountainside is prone to collapse.

Japanese.Text: 登山中に命を落とす者も多く　そのため

English.Text: That treacherous terrain has claimed the lives of many climbers.

Japanese.Text:
死者の国と繋がっているといった
伝説もあるそうです

English.Text: In that sense, it is connected to the land of the dead.

Japanese.Text:
ニブルヘイムを調べてみたのですが
のどかな見た目に反して　謎が多い集落ですね

English.Text: Cursory investigation suggests Nibelheim is a quaint, mountain village, yet it feels...off.

Japanese.Text:
ほとんどの記録が極秘になっています
どうやら　宝条博士が関わっていたようです

English.Text: Almost all records are highly classified, and it seems Professor Hojo is somehow involved as well.

Japanese.Text:
ニブルヘイムは　世界で初めて
魔晄炉が建設された地域なのもあって

English.Text: I should note that the world's first mako reactor was built here in Nibelheim.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄を使った様々な実験が
行われていたと言います

English.Text: Shinra used its energy to conduct a range of experiments.

Japanese.Text:
ここが魔晄中毒者の療養施設になっているのは
偶然なのでしょうか？

English.Text: Is it mere coincidence that this place now hosts a mako poisoning treatment center?

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
ニブルエリアの調査は　これにて完了です！

English.Text: It would appear you have completed our survey of the Nibel region, Cloud.

Japanese.Text:
現在の神羅カンパニーは　この場所から
始まったと言っても過言ではありません

English.Text: One could argue that this is where the Shinra Electric Power Company truly began.

Japanese.Text:
魔晄と関わりの深い土地を調べることで
様々な問題が　浮き彫りになった気がします

English.Text: Consequently, it's no surprise that your investigations identified a multitude of concerns.

Japanese.Text: 意義あるレポートの提供　ありがとうございました

English.Text: Let's hope our partnership leads to lasting solutions.

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud!

Japanese.Text:
死者の国からやってきた高潔な騎士
『オーディン』を仮想空間に再現しました！

English.Text: Odin, the noble knight hailing from the land of the dead, has been recreated within virtual space.

Japanese.Text:
召喚マテリアを生成するためにも
ぜひ　バトルデータの収集にご協力ください

English.Text: I encourage you to pit your skills against this summoned entity, so that I might complete its materia.

Japanese.Text: まさか　オーディンに勝ってしまうなんて……

English.Text: Besting Odin... You've done the unthinkable!

Japanese.Text:
ひとつのミスが命に直結する高次元の攻防に
瞬きすらできませんでした

English.Text: A single mistake could have spelled certain doom, but your persistence paid off in the end.

Japanese.Text:
これからは　すべてを断ち切る斬鉄剣が
みなさんの未来を切りひらいてくれるでしょう！

English.Text: With his mighty Zantetsuken, this master of the blade will certainly help you cut a path to victory!

Japanese.Text:
ふう……チョコボ仙人の元で学ぶのは
根気が必要ですね

English.Text: It requires a great deal of patience to learn from the chocobo sage.

Japanese.Text: この村は　なんだか宝条博士の気配がするんです

English.Text: Professor Hojo has certainly left his mark on this town, hasn't he?

Japanese.Text:
宝条博士を超えるためにも
ここで研究をしてみるのもいいかもしれません

English.Text: I suppose that makes it a fitting place for me to endeavor to surpass his research.

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん　ライフスポットより
珍しいモンスターの情報を入手しました

English.Text: Good news, Cloud. That lifespring yielded information on a very rare fiend!

Japanese.Text:
ニブルの空を支配する怪物
『キングズー』のすみかがわかりました

English.Text: The king zu rules the skies of Nibel, and now we know where it roosts!

Japanese.Text:
どうやら　黒マントさんに被害が出ているようです
早急に調査と討伐をお願いします

English.Text: Seeing as this taloned terror has been causing trouble for the black robes, I suggest that you clip its wings.

Japanese.Text: キングズーの討伐　お疲れ様です！

English.Text: Excellent work dethroning the king zu!

Japanese.Text:
クラウド様をエサだと勘違いしたのが運の尽き
空の支配者を見事　返り討ちにしましたね

English.Text: Attempting to prey upon you proved his undoing─and without that winged terror flying around, the skies are clear once more.

Japanese.Text:
これで　黒マントのみなさんも
安心してニブルで暮らせるはずです！

English.Text: Those robed folks must be breathing a collective sigh of relief!

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさん
ライフストリームを調べたところ

English.Text: Cloud! By analyzing the lifespring data...

Japanese.Text:
共和国時代のクラフトチップが
埋まっている場所がわかりました

English.Text: I was able to locate an old republic transmuter chip.

Japanese.Text: 近海にある　離島を探してみてください

English.Text: It should be on a nearby island.

Japanese.Text:
ニブルで魔晄を発見した神羅は
離島に防衛基地を建設したそうです

English.Text: Once they discovered mako in the area, Shinra established an offshore outpost.

Japanese.Text:
すでに基地は撤去されていますので
神羅に攻撃される心配はありませんよ

English.Text: Oh, but they've long since vacated the isle, so I doubt you'll run afoul of their forces.

Japanese.Text:
クラウド様　ありがとうございます！
今回手に入った戦闘データを使って

English.Text: Stellar performance, Cloud! I can't thank you enough for providing such valuable combat intel.

Japanese.Text:
わたくしのガイド能力を
さらに強化することができます！

English.Text: I'll use this data to further enhance my guidance functionality!

Japanese.Text: 貴重なデータを　そんなことには使いません

English.Text: That would be a grave misuse of our resources.

Japanese.Text: ええ～　そんなあ

English.Text: Requesting attitude adjustment.

Japanese.Text:
今回のデータを流用して
コンバットコースを作成しましたので

English.Text: In any case, I've utilized the data for a new challenge.

Japanese.Text:
おひまな時にでも　バトルシミュレーターに
挑戦してみてくださいね

English.Text: Feel free to access it via the combat simulator when you have the time!

Japanese.Text:
ニブルの討伐依頼は　これにて完了です
わたくしのガイドはいかがだったでしょう？

English.Text: Well done! You've completed all combat assignments in Nibel─no doubt thanks to my quality guidance.

Japanese.Text:
ＭＡＩは　ちょっとしゃべりすぎですね
口数を減らすように調整しておきます

English.Text: Or in spite of your excessive chatter. I need to adjust the speech frequency setting...

Japanese.Text:
あ～ん　クラウド様～
マスターがいじめる～～～

English.Text: No! Stop him, Cloud! He's trying to silence me!

Japanese.Text:
さて　今回もクラウドさんのおかげで
新たなコンバットコースを作ることができました

English.Text: Anyway, thanks to your hard work, Cloud, I was able to devise another combat trial.

Japanese.Text: 自信作なので　ぜひ挑戦してみてください

English.Text: I'm confident this one will pose quite a challenge.

Japanese.Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud.

Japanese.Text:
以前の調査から時間が経ってしまったので
状況を説明しますね

English.Text: It's been some time since you were last here, so let me refresh your memory.

Japanese.Text:
エンシェントマターを持っている黒マントさんが
この島のどこかにいらっしゃるはずです

English.Text: A black-robed individual on this island is in possession of a protorelic.

Japanese.Text:
ニブルの調査は　これが最後になります
準備をしっかり整えてから向かってください

English.Text: You need only locate and secure it to see our Nibelheim investigation to its conclusion.

Japanese.Text:
ニブルの祠には　戦と死を司る騎士
『オーディン』の知識が眠っているようです

English.Text: Slumbering within the Nibel sanctuaries is Odin, the patron knight of war and death.

Japanese.Text:
愛馬スレイプニルにまたがり
死者の国からやってきたオーディンが

English.Text: He rides in from the land of the dead astride his steed, Sleipnir...

Japanese.Text:
戦士たちの命を刈り取っていく……
そういった伝承が数多く残っています

English.Text: claiming the souls of fallen warriors as his own─or so the stories say.

Japanese.Text: ニブルに残る伝承によれば

English.Text: According to local legend...

Japanese.Text:
オーディンが持つ斬鉄剣は
あらゆるものを断ち斬ると言われています

English.Text: Odin's Zantetsuken is capable of cleaving anything in two...

Japanese.Text: 空間を斬り　時間を斬り　そして存在を斬る

English.Text: be it the fabric of creation or the time between the seconds.

Japanese.Text: ふふふ　すいません

English.Text: Heh heh... You know...

Japanese.Text:
クラウドさんが　まっぷたつになるところを
想像してしまいました

English.Text: not to compare swords, but his might trump yours.

Japanese.Text:
ニブル山を越えた先に
死者の国があるという言い伝えがありますが

English.Text: It has been said that the land of the dead lies just beyond Mt. Nibel.

Japanese.Text:
その派生として　オーディンが
死者の国の門番をしているといった話もあります

English.Text: From this belief arises the conception of Odin as a gatekeeper of the afterlife...

Japanese.Text:
まだ死ぬべきでない者が来た時は
追い返すそうです

English.Text: one who turns away all whose time has not yet come.

Japanese.Text:
これで　ニブルにあるクリスタルは
すべて解析できました　お疲れ様です

English.Text: I've managed to analyze all the crystals located in Nibel. Thank you for your help!

Japanese.Text:
オーディンに　さらに強くなってもらって
敵を死者の国に連れていってもらいましょう

English.Text: Odin will serve as a powerful ally, whisking your foes away to the land of the dead.

Japanese.Text:
でも　クラウドさんは
まだ召喚マテリアをお持ちじゃなかったですね

English.Text: Though you have yet to obtain the requisite materia, as I recall.

Japanese.Text:
まずは　バトルシミュレーターで
召喚獣に挑戦してみてください！

English.Text: You'll first need to confront the divine via the combat simulator!

Japanese.Text:
クラウド様
キングズーの生息地に到着しました
